works.title: Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation: Mo Dao Zu Shi
works.synopsis: Feared and hated for his sinister abilities, Wei Wuxian–the grandmaster of demonic cultivation–was driven to his death when the most powerful clans united to destroy him. Thirteen years later, Wei Wuxian is reborn. Summoned by a young man who sacrificed his soul in a forbidden ritual, Wei Wuxian is now bound to seek vengeance on the stranger’s behalf or risk the destruction of his own soul. But when an evil entity emerges, a familiar face from Wei Wuxian’s past suddenly appears amidst the chaos–Lan Wangji, a powerful cultivator who will help shine a light on the dark truths that surround them. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

works.title: Versatile Mage
works.synopsis: Our hero, Mo Fan, inherits a magical necklace—the next day, he wakes up to find that the world has changed. His high school now teaches magic, and students are encouraged to try and become accomplished magicians. A world that ran on science now runs on magic. However, some things are still the same. He still has a teacher who sees him as a hopeless student, classmates who look the same, a father who struggles to make ends meet, and a not-by-blood little sister who can't walk on her own. However, Mo Fan discovers that the vast majority of magicians can only harness one element of magic. As luck would have it, however, he is an exception—a versatile mage! (Source: WebNovel)

works.title: Lord of Mysteries
works.synopsis: Zhou Mingrui possessed and reborn Klein Moretti who committed suicide due to the sealed artifact "Antigonus Family Notes". Zhou Mingrui once again held a "Transfer Ceremony" in order to return to Earth, but accidentally entered a mysterious gray fog space. During this process, he inadvertently pulled the consciousnesses of Audrey Hall and Alger Wilson into the gray fog space. In order to dominate the conversation and pretend to be a hidden existence in recovery, Mr. Fool, who calls himself Mr. Fool, has since embarked on a magnificent legend of becoming a god. (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: The King's Avatar
works.synopsis: In the multiplayer online game Glory, Ye Xiu, is well known as the Textbook level expert and a top-tier player. Due to a series of circumstances, he was forcefully expelled out of his professional team. After leaving the pro gaming scene, he resides at an Internet Café employed as one of the managers. When Glory launches the tenth server, he throws himself into the game once more, equipped with ten years of gaming experience, memories of the past and an incomplete self-made weapon. His journey back to the top begins. After plotting and scheming, who took away my glory? Under the influence of the storm, my hopes will never be shattered. In its magnificence, the path will not be lost, for I, will return! The manhua is based on the popular Quan Zhi Gao Shou novel by Butterfly Blue. The manhua is currently serialized digitally in Da Jiao Chong’s mobile application and is released on a weekly basis.

works.title: The Great Ruler
works.synopsis: The Great Thousand World. It is a place where numerous planes intersect, a place where many clans live and a place where a group of lords assemble. The Heavenly Sovereigns appear one by one from the Lower Planes and they will all display a legend that others would desire as they pursue the road of being a ruler in this boundless world. In the Endless Fire Territory that the Flame Emperor controls, thousands of fire blazes through the heavens. Inside the Martial Realm, the power of the Martial Ancestor frightens the heaven and the earth. At the West Heaven Temple, the might of the Emperor of a Hundred Battles is absolute. In the Northern Desolate Hill, a place filled with thousands of graves, the Immortal Owner rules the world. A boy from the Northern Spiritual Realm comes out, riding on a Nine Netherworld Bird, as he charges into the brilliant and diverse world. Just who can rule over their destiny of their path on becoming a Great Ruler? In the Great Thousand World, many strive to become a Great Ruler. (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: The King's Avatar
works.synopsis: No one could ever come close to “Battle God” Ye Qiu’s skills in Glory, a popular game that took the world by storm. His professional team, however, replaced him with another captain, and even seized his account. He was left to start anew at an internet cafe as a manager. When a new District 10 opened up in Glory, he dives back, armed with a decade of experience and an unfinished custom weapon. His path to redemption, filled with strategy and memories, marks his thrilling return to the summit. (Source: Tapas)

works.title: I, the Strongest Demon, Have Regained My Youth?!
works.ar: 最强魔君的我，突然变小了?!
works.synopsis: In order to maintain his rule, Xin Sheng, the eternal demon king who ruled the world, went deep into the demon realm to find the highest and strongest power. Thousands of years later, he has become stronger and younger, and the world has also changed... (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Eternal Love
works.synopsis: When Wen Yifan returns to her hometown for work, she runs into the super hot guy everyone's talking about. However, this super hottie turns out to be Sang Yan, the guy whose feelings she crushed when she rejected him back in high school! In a twist of fate, two paths that remained separate all that time now seem to be intertwined as they keep bumping into each other. What's more, they coincidentally end up renting the same apartment and becoming roommates! Watch how Sang Yan, dubbed the "perfect boyfriend”, navigates his way through love amidst a whirlwind of unspoken feelings and strong emotions! (Source: Pocket Comics)

works.title: The Door to Fantasy World
works.synopsis: A gift from the heaven! Being possessed by another type of blood! All the celestial are frightened! Thousands of demons withdraw! A youth from the Eastern Continent, a female skull accompanying him, a story about resolving to be strong, and a legend which shakes heaven and moves the earth. (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Bloodbath of the Fallen: The Reborn Hero Gron
works.synopsis: The mighty hero died in a final battle with the Demon Emperor. Five years later, he awakens in the demon camp, reborn as the weakest of their kind. But his soul triggers the ancient Serpent God’s power hidden within his body. Once a hero feared by villains, he now walks the world in a demon’s body. And this time, the bloodbath he unleashes will shake both sides of the war. (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Somewhere in Time
works.synopsis: Our protagonist, Shen Jun, is the lead singer and guitarist of the band Triumph of William, who fails to be cool at the very beginning. Another protagonist, Yu Zhixing, a little-known painter, is obsessed with his neighbor Shen Jun, but unfortunately, has nohas no chance to interact with himafraid to interaction with him. As he tries everything to talk to his neighbor, there it is, Shen Jun's cat is outside of his door?! He finally finds an excuse to talk to Shen Jun? (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Quan Qiu Yi Neng: Kaiju Juexing Zi Xiao Shen Lei
works.ar: 全球异能：开局觉醒紫霄神雷
works.synopsis: In the world of Blue Star, fierce beasts are rampant. Everyone can awaken superpowers and have the opportunity to become a strong man and dominate the world! However, Xu Jingming, who traveled through time, only had E-level superpowers. Fortunately, the Deep Blue System appeared, and the E-level weak electric superpower was upgraded to S-level Purple Thunder! Killing fierce beasts will earn you superpower points! Superpower points -1500000, Purple Thunder will evolve! SSS-level Chaos Thunder! Thus, the legend of Xu Jingming was left on Blue Star. (Source: KuaiKan, translated)

works.title: Soul Land - The Legendary Gods' Realm
works.ar: 斗罗大陆外传神界传说
works.synopsis: Due to the God of Goodness and the God of Evil's reincarnation and changes, the Divine Realm's internal strife has been gradually increasing. The God of Destruction is the head of a faction opposed to Sea Asura God who heads another faction, eventually leading to war. However, it is at this time that the Sea Asura God's wife has become pregnant. Tang San has a premonition that a crisis bigger than the Divine Realm’s internal conflict is about to arrive. What is this crisis? The Legend of the Divine Realm is set after Peerless Tang Sect and in this story, many familiar characters will appear once again. Note: Chapter count includes four extras chapters.

works.title: Breaking Through the Clouds 2: Devouring the Seas
works.synopsis: Wu Yu, a newcomer to the Public Security Bureau, is gentle and frail. He doesn’t care about the difficulties posed by Bu ChongHua, his strict boss, and only wants to stay in the background and be paid on time with enough to sustain himself. However, no one knows that he is being targeted by top drug traffickers for a large bounty, or that this courageous young man had previously slaughtered the dragon of the abyss. With a chain of interlocking cases, a series of troubles come one after another. Can these two work together to survive the difficulties? (Source: INKR)

works.title: Kaiju You Jianyu, Wo Nenggou Cheng Jianshen
works.ar: 开局有剑域，我能苟成剑神
works.synopsis: Zhang Fan transmigrated into another world and finally became a cultivator. But he was betrayed and lost all of his cultivated powers, leaving him on the verge of death, when his System finally came online. Now gods, demons, and immortals are nothing compared to him. The invincible Zhang Fan wanted to draw his sword and conquer the world, but it turns out his powers have a limited range. To gain experience and expand his territory, he must lure his enemies to come to him. Thus, the legend was born about how he overcame countless enemies to gain immortality with his sword. (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Luo Xiaohei Zhan Ji: Lanxi Zhen
works.synopsis: Lanxi Town tells the story of Laojun, Xuanli, and Qingning during the war. It shows a different world of demons and gods. (Source: Beijing United Publishing, translated)

works.title: Blue Wings
works.synopsis: Adopted into a strange family to replace their recently deceased daughter, Skye hasn’t had it easy. Her brothers torment her daily and her new adoptive mother is terminally ill. Can Skye survive and finally seize her own happiness? A relatable story exploring trust, friendship, love and the ever uncertainty of the future. (Source: Tapas)

works.title: My Pretty Tenants
works.synopsis: His name is Qin Ruo and he is a very dangerous person; with handsome but somewhat nasty gaze, he gives rather complicated impressions to others. Owning a third-story villa with a huge swimming pool, he is literally a rich guy but what he only lacks is a hot female companion! "Can I stay here?" she knocked open his door. He ogled her curved body with his eyes almost popping out and welcomed her in... (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Whirlpool in Vernal Reverie
works.synopsis: Introverted high schooler Xuting is used to being the target of bullies, but her life takes a dramatic turn when a new, mysteriously handsome repairman intervenes. Captivated by his quiet strength and grateful for his protection, Xuting feels an undeniable pull towards him. Yet, her world shatters when she stumbles upon his terrifying secret: he's a werewolf. Now, caught between burgeoning feelings and monstrous danger, Xuting must navigate a terrifying new reality where her protector might just be her greatest threat. (Source: WebComics)

works.title: The Supreme Reincarnated
works.synopsis: The Emperor of Thunder, Chen Lei, failed in his ascension, and as fate would have it, he reincarnated back to his teenage days when his family hadn't been destroyed and his parents hadn’t died tragically. Chen Lei is determined to make up for his regrets! With memories of his past life, Chen Lei, with his enormous talents, embarks on his ultimate journey to become invincible—to protect his family, to crush his enemies, and attain all the treasures in the world. When he’s drunk, he’s surrounded by pretty women; when he’s sober, he’s the invincible supreme with the power to control the world! (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Checkmate! Capture My Heart
works.synopsis: Xiaotao likes his college senior Bo, and Bo likes Xiaotao, but neither of them is smooth enough to tell the other how they feel! Luckily, Bo’s sister is a popular BL writer and knows every romance trick in the book. Xiaotao, on the other hand, has an overenthusiastic BL-reading sister in his corner. Each new day means a different strategy to bring the lovebirds together. With such good intentions and expertise on their side, it should be smooth sailing from here… right?! (Source: Tapas) Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

works.title: Cao Zong Wo Xin
works.synopsis: It's been three years since she escaped from Ibella's control. She thought she could finally live a peaceful life, free from surveillance and manipulation. But her new life hasn't gone well at all. Her girlfriend cheated on her, work is stressful, and her parents are badgering her to get married. It's almost too much to bear, like she's just gone from one hell to another. And then Ibella reappeared in her life. Will she surrender her body and soul to become a plaything once again? (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: The Incapable Married Princess
works.synopsis: For my country, I was prepared to sacrifice myself, even for marriage. But the one I had to marry happened to be a girl. I had thought I had pranked the goddess pranker, but unexpectedly the goddess had pranked me.

works.title: Handling the Demoness and Saintess
works.ar: 魔女与圣女的使用方法
works.synopsis: My father remarried to a beautiful stepmother and they traveled abroad. My new aunt Qianhe of the same age moved into the house. I thought I was going to start a life that I wouldn’t be ashamed of, but I didn’t expect my aunt to be a demon-slaying immortal, and I Sanqiu to be highly coveted by demons. Attacks continued… but I was surprised to find out that my childhood sweetheart Xiaoyou, who I haven’t seen for many years, turned out to be the strongest assassin of the Deity management organization “Banished Deity Bureau.” And now she has feelings of hostility towards Qianhe, who she sees as her rival in love…..

works.title: Mr. Dior
works.synopsis: A silly story about two corporate presidents who have been married for seven years. The submissive one accidentally hit his head too hard, and suddenly became the dominant one in the relationship. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: The Grandmaster of Body Cultivation
works.synopsis: Ye Cangxuan, the grandmaster of Body-strengthening Cultivation died while passing through the Eternal Heavenly Tribulation. When he wakes up again, he becomes mortal and returns to the sect he founded. This time, the invincible grandmaster is set to punish the villains and restore his godly might! (Source: WebComics)

works.title: The Day I Woke up as the Sacrificial Princess
works.synopsis: Despite carrying royal blood, Bryanna lived outside of the palace for most of her life. Upon returning to the palace, she discovers Lilian, the emperor's illegitimate daughter who successfully charmed the emperor with her "adorableness." In the original novel of this story, when the emperor has to offer the life of one of his daughters to the gods, he decides to sacrifice Lilian instead of Bryanna, but Lilian survives and Bryanna dies at the age of 18. However, now there is a new soul in Bryanna's body, and she is determined to go against the original plot. (Source: Tappytoon)

works.title: 48 Hours a Day
works.synopsis: The God of Time – Khronos – gave Zhang Heng an incredible gift. Time freezes at the end of the day for everyone except Zhang Heng, who gains an additional 24 hours. In exchange, Zhang Heng must act as the agent for the God of Time and participate in a dangerous game each month: Deserted Island Survival [Mission Objective: Survive for 40 days], Tokyo Drift [Mission Objective: Win the underground street racing championship], and so on… As Zhang Heng stacks up victory after victory, he is also getting closer to the truth of this world. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Jiuyang Shenwang
works.synopsis: The fallen emperor Qin Yun, the inheritance of Jiuyang, awakened the world of martial arts, learned the skills of the world. Since then, he has been on the Xiuwu Avenue. A variety of martial arts strong, in order to seek his refining, willing to serve as his younger brother.

works.title: Energy Hunters
works.synopsis: Gu Xinghe is a high school student with few words. After a mysterious bloody red rain, he suddenly found he became the target of a group of monstrous creatures, "the Death Disciples." Whatsmore, his beloved friend Lu Yang fell into a coma on his birthday from the monsters' attack, while Xinghe was saved by a girl with tremendous power. To save his friend, Xinghe joined the "Energy Hunters" academy that the girl attends, and start training to fight the "Death Disciples" and other dark powers. (Source: Mangatoon)

works.title: Intoxicated Love
works.synopsis: Having a secret crush is just like drinking a bottle of hard liquor. You clearly know that it will make you light-headed, lose your cool, and suffer. Yet, just like a moth to the flames, you endure the pain knowingly. "You stop right after having a sip of it but, as for me… I'm drunk in love." However, inevitably, you finally sober up after being drunk. This is a story about doing everything possible just to continue having a secret crush and learning to love someone.

works.title: What Do I Do? The Female Lead Has Emerged From The Book
works.ar: 女主从书里跑出来了怎么办
works.synopsis: Chu Ge is a writer of generic harem webnovels. As he was writing the storyline about how the world's strongest female warrior was going to fall in love, a woman suddenly appeared in his room. She pointed a sword at his neck and told him, "If you dare to write about me falling for that man, I will kill you!" (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Wo Duo She Le Modao Zu Shi Ye
works.synopsis: A kind young man accidentally transmigrated into the body of the master of the villainous demonic sect, just as the master lost his powers due to the thousand-year limit. Facing betrayal by his own disciples and attacks by other righteous sects, he must complete the missions issued by the Absolute System in order to survive. But those missions — are all about doing good and being helpful!? (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Flaming Hot Desire
works.synopsis: After her boyfriend cheats on her, Luo Yaoyao lets loose, gets drunk at a bar... and makes a move on the king of the underworld after mistaking him for a simple male host. Shoot -- she had better run quick! But could running away really be that easy? Dream on! Two years later, she takes a temporary job at China's number one company. And little does she know that her nightmare is just getting started... (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Kaiju Jianren Hei Long boss, Wo Wudile
works.ar: 开局兼任黑龙boss，我无敌了
works.synopsis: Kaiju Jianren Hei Long boss, Wo Wudile is available in the Lorefy Manhua catalog.

works.title: God of War
works.synopsis: Five years ago, their schemes caused the downfall of his father's company. For the sake of his father's medical treatment, he suffered humiliation from his relatives, and he was even heartlessly abandoned by his fiancée and left to die in a river. Five years later, he returned as a general with monstrous authority. His goal? Payback! (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: June and Alice
works.synopsis: June, an oriental girl in a foreign country, becomes the queen's dress-up doll to make a living! June wants to escape once she earns enough money, but she gets caught up in a bigger conspiracy struggle for power. (Source: WebComics) Note: Chapter count includes 2 bonus chapters.

works.title: Revolutionary
works.synopsis: Fang Zheng, the head of the Ministry of Justice in the Da Xi Dynasty abhorred evil, a stance that antagonised many against him. Surrounded and attacked from all sides by his enemies, Fang Zheng died on Cang Luan mountain. But his soul would resurrect in a weak child, along with the memories of his past life, his passionate desire for justice, and his belief in punishing evil with evil. Fang Zheng will strike down those in his path without mercy until he becomes the most revered and respected on both heaven and earth.

works.title: Lost Powers Restored: Unlocking a New Skill Every Day
works.ar: 灵气复苏，我每天get一个新技能
works.synopsis: When spiritual power reawakened in the world, Lin Qiu, who had the weakest aura, was chosen by System 9527 to be granted a new skill every day. “Congratulations, master! You’ve obtained the skill 'Spread Your Seed'"! Wow, that sounds exciting? "Congratulations, master! You’ve obtained the skill 'Skill Enhancement'”! What, I can upgrade and get even stronger? Watch Lin Qiu game the system and turn his no-good life around! (Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)

works.title: Chongsheng Moxiu, Kaiju Jian Dao Yi Ke Sangshi Xingqiu
works.ar: 重生魔修，开局捡到一颗丧尸星球
works.synopsis: Chu Xuan transmigrated into a world of cultivation and became a demon cultivator of Wuji Sect. So-called demonic cultivation involves the plundering of the essences of the heaven, earth, and all things. Only by slaughtering thousands of people can one become the Great Demon Lord. However, such killing is not tolerated by the heavenly order, and the Wuji Sect was hunted down and destroyed by the righteous sects. Resigned to his fate, Chu Xuan accidentally found the Blood Mirror, which allowed him to travel to a post-apocalyptic planet full of zombies! He suddenly realizes that this place is the perfect environment for demon cultivation! (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: Your Ears Are Showing!
works.synopsis: What kind of chemistry would happen between a homebody and a teenager with cat ears? Will the recluse's new roommate change his homebound tendencies? (Source: Webnovel) Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.

works.title: The Immortal In Me
works.synopsis: The short-lived prodigy, Shi Jiang, just seven years old, is growing up super fast. In order to restore normal life, he broke into the fairy world with a great fairy who was boarding in his body, and then embarked on the legendary road of becoming a fairy tycoon... (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Jintian Yiding Yao Dui (Rang) Ni Gaobai
works.ar: 今天一定要对（让）你告白
works.synopsis: The life of two "normal" high school girls? Su Mu wants to overcome her anxiety and confess to Lin Daixue. On the other side Daixue keeps leaving openings for Su Mu to confess. Both of them know each other's feelings but neither of them is willing to be truthful to the other.

works.title: God’s Identity Card
works.synopsis: God’s Identity Card: Lu Lanqiao, a forensic science student, became the most likely suspect in the murder of his elder brother overnight. His brother's last words put him on the run. While trying to find out who killed his brother, Lanqiao met Fu Cheng, the police inspector who was hot on his trail. However, the relationship between the fugitive and the pursuer gradually changed… (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Rhodes Island's Records Of Originium - Rhine Lab
works.ar: 罗德岛源石记事——莱茵生命
works.synopsis: Ifrit met an uninvited guest at Rhodes Island: Dalia. Ifrit, Silence, and Saria can see the shadows of their past in Dalia's appearance. This causes them to start recalling their memories of what previously happened... (Source: Official Site, translated)

works.title: Bring A Wolf Home
works.synopsis: There are many reasons why Xia Xu and Bai Li should not be together. For one, Xia Xu is a poor half-vampire, while Bai Li is the werewolf CEO of the prestigious White Wolf Group. But things take an unexpected turn when Bai Li’s young nephew, Luo Bo, gets lost while heading to the CEO’s office. Xia Xu takes the helpless wolf cub back home with him, not knowing that the boy’s furious uncle is on his way to completely destroy the vampire’s house in search of him. Now having no place to go, Xia Xu begins to live with the two werewolves until his place gets repaired. And with a playful pup between them, the two men from different worlds begin to grow closer and closer… (Source: Tappytoon) Note: Includes six extra chapters.

works.title: Reborn: House of Revenge
works.synopsis: Her father was missing when she was 3 years old; her hand tendon was cut when she was 15; her mother died in a planned car accident when she was 16; she was framed by her relatives when she was 19; she was burnt alive by her newlywed husband and friend when she was 22. Perhaps the god pities her and makes her reborn to the age of 15. She kept a low profile in the previous life but ended up with being betrayed miserably; this time she will not show any weakness and make those who harmed her pay with their lives! (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: 1st Kiss
works.synopsis: He is her younger brother, although the two have no blood relationship but she always considers him to be her biological brother … can only be brother that’s all. of course he doesn’t want to be like that, but he is also afraid that he will create distance with her more and more far away. If their first meeting in life was not like that, would they have another result? The girl he loves is right in front of his eyes but is like a wind and can’t hold … Can only as younger brother? How must he do to let her know that he can also become a guardian for her whole life?

works.title: Human Scanner
works.synopsis: An accident gave an ordinary boy, Ye Han, the magical power to see through practically anything, and his life has become colorful since then. He has built the strongest business empire, dominated the world of gambling, raised people from the dead with his medical skills and became a divine physician and a billionaire, which made beautiful girls fall for him. However, a shocking plot and secret is going to hit him... (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Kai Gua Wanjia Cong 0 Shengji
works.synopsis: Born poor in the slums, Sun Ran is a naturally gifted game hacker. He used many alt characters running cheats in various virtual worlds to make money outside the law, until he got caught and banned by the admins, which also cost him a nine-hundred-million fine. To pay for his debts, he worked out a deal with the central computer, to become the upholder of justice. He will face off against the game hackers and cheating players in a fierce battle of wits. (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: Jian Ge Mowang Dang Nüpu
works.synopsis: What would you do if you got yourself a big-breasted maid? This maid even has silvery hair and red eyes like a goddess. That sounds… kinda awesome… But… wait… wait a minute… how can my maid be the demon lord? That's not how this was suppose to go!? My dear Demon Lord, please change out of those clothes and I will take you home right away. (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Developer Of The Netherworld
works.synopsis: While working at his part-time job, he saw his girlfriend going to a love-hotel with another man! To win his girlfriend back, Yao Bing will set out on the path to revenge by becoming a real estate developer in Hell. Along the way, he'll recruit minions, seduce beauties, and uncover the hidden plot behind his girlfriend's actions. You might have looked down on me before, but now you'll all be bowing down to me! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Icebound Doom: No Way Out
works.ar: 冰封末日：绝无生还之路
works.synopsis: A deadly winter storm. An imminent apocalypse. Terrifying monsters. Impossible choices. This is the ultimate story of survival of a boy who dies and comes back to life. (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Jue Bu He Huli Zuo Pengyou de Tuzi
works.ar: 绝不和狐狸做朋友的兔子
works.synopsis: One is a rabbit girl with a congenital defect, and the other is a fox girl that's super popular but has a lonely heart. Despite their differences, they are each other's precious 'The Other Me in This World'. When they meet, a story of mutual healing and mutual growth begins... (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: Nansheng Sushe 303
works.synopsis: The stupid antics of four dudes living together, their “no pain, no gain” lifestyle in school, and maybe there’ll be some romance in the mix. (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: The Queen Is Busy
works.synopsis: A 19-year-old girl named Qing Tian was suddenly transported in time to an unknown dynasty. At first, she thought she could slowly enter the battles of the harem, but she’s surprised to find out that she's actually the Queen! How did this messy story come to be?? Note: Includes prologue and five bonus chapters.

works.title: The Last Hero
works.synopsis: Level up in the apocalypse, unlock evolutionary genes, and begin evolving to the extreme! It is the end of the world and no one is safe. Yang Hao was forced out from his shelter to survive on his own but inadvertently discovered the "Attribute Acquisition System" during a moment of crisis. "Attributes Acquired: Strength +1, Speed +1." "Acquired Mutated Attribute: Blood Awakening!" Thus, he proclaimed: "From today onwards, all the food, women, and lands that I desire shall be mine!" Since then, the mountains of corpses including mutants, evolved beasts, and ancient warriors paved a bloody path for him to ascend to the title of King of the Apocalypse! (Source: INKR) Note: Chapter count includes a prologue chapter.

works.title: The Ultimate School Doctor
works.synopsis: To fulfill the last wish of his grandpa, Xiong Yu returned to Shangcheng and planned to marry Qiu Hongxin, a beautiful president of a university, but he was refused because the engagement was arranged before they were born and they didn't have feelings for each other. To nurture their relationship, Xiong Yu became a TCM physician in the school hospital. At this point, his good luck in adventures with women just began... (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Era of the Haunted
works.synopsis: Desperate to escape the streets after being discarded by his parents, Flynn finds hope at Willow City Necromancy Academy. There, his hidden spirit talents ignite. Crushing specters and gaining powerful spirit allies, Flynn eclipses his peers. Hailed as a prodigy, Flynn harbors a secret ambition: to become the strongest necromancer fueled by revenge from those who cast him out. As a specter horde marches, can the vengeful prodigy become a hero, or will his fury consume him? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Gonglüe Mowang De Nüsheng Qinshi
works.synopsis: The modern-day lady-assassin found herself transmigrated into a trashy European-fantasy otome game, where she has to make the Demon Lord fall in love with her in order to save the world. Instead, she trained the villainess Lady Lisa in assassin's skills, hoping that Lisa would eventually kill her and allow her to return to the real world. But all that intimate physical contact and her own earnestness during the training caused Lisa to fall in love with her instead?

works.title: The Nightingale and the Rose
works.synopsis: One day, the game streamer Bai Xinxin transmigrated into the role of the princess Bai Yueguang in the mystery game "Nightingale and the Rose". But all the characters in this game were out to kill her, and only Lan Sha, the player character, could protect her. Amongst all the jealous yanderes and murderous rivals, Bai Yueguang has to use all her wits to fight off enemies known and unknown, while finding a way to survive with Lan Sha by her side. However, this main character "Lan Sha" also seems a bit...?! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Han Yuan
works.synopsis: This is a story of Little Princess Luo trying to make a friend. Luo Linyuan is born with a silver spoon in his mouth and a pretty face. Yu Han is "straight", and he sleeps only three hours a day. Yu Han doesn't want Luo Linyuan to get close to him, but Luo Linyuan wants otherwise. (Source: Bilibili Comics) Note: Chapter count includes 5 extras.

works.title: Spun Together
works.synopsis: A young yarn shop owner, Mao Rong, was raised to believe love could touch people’s lives. That all changed when he met Yang Yusheng, a popular but rude artist disgusted by the touch of other people. After accidentally injuring Yang Yusheng’s hand, Mao Rong promises to nurse him back to good health. Cooking, cleaning, Mao Rong does his best to make things right despite Yang Yusheng telling him he’s doing everything wrong. Little does he know Mao Rong’s touch is the first that makes him feel… good. Can Mao Rong knit Yang Yusheng back together? And why is Yang Yusheng afraid of skin contact? The strings of fate have been tied together! (Source: Tapas, edited)

works.title: Wo Neng Ti Qu Shuxing
works.synopsis: I, Gu Shaoyang, have the ability to extract and fuse other people's attributes. Extracting the foundational talents from geniuses, I instantly became the most fearsome cultivator in the world. Fusing cheap stones and useless potions, I can create priceless gems and godly elixirs. Now I just want to know: when will I be invincible?!! (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: Swallow an Immortal World
works.synopsis: The lord of the four divine worlds, lord Xiao, was betrayed by his brother. He set up a death trap that killed Xiao. After millennia, the soul of the lord found a vessel, bringing Xiao Fan back to life. Spilled divine blood, captured heavenly castle, unclear fate of his beloved wife - all this kindled the all-consuming fire of hatred in his heart. And now he intends to return to his divine abode behind the heads of traitors and take their lives! Possessing the almighty Dantian, he will open heaven and earth, absorb darkness and light, destroy yin and yang! Note: Includes two extra chapters.

works.title: Wan Dao Cheng Shen
works.synopsis: Nine regions fight for control of the world, and one shot determines everything! A young villager with a desire to get stronger starts on the slow path of cultivation. A life changing mystery! A competition between nine regions! The winner becomes king! What is in store for him?

works.title: Sword Journey
works.synopsis: Born in a stone, I was treated as a little monster. When I‘ve grown up, I fulfilled my master’s wish – to marry into my wife’s family. From then on, I got a nickname “kept man”. However, nobody knows that I am the most extraordinary swordsman in the world. I don’t care whether they call me monster or Zhui Xu(son-in-law living in the home of his wife’s parents). Just wait and see how I conquer the world! (Source: WeComics)

works.title: Wo Shi Bawang
works.synopsis: Having suffered humiliation in youth and then moving forward with exceptional martial talent, to inherit the role of the overlord, to ride the king of demon beasts, break through all obstacles and seize back his family estate, ascend to the pinnacle of the martial arts world and flip the order of heavens!

works.title: You Long Shou Hu De Xiao Zhen
works.synopsis: Hua Dai found herself with an illness - whenever she touches something she wants/likes, her hands will get stuck to it until she buys it. Due to this illness, she is in great debt. Without choice, she decided to go back to her grandpa's house with this secret key her grandpa gave her in search of treasure, hoping to pay off her debts. As Hua Dai arrived at Bai Lin Village, she found a girl namd "Long" who claimed to be a disciple of her grandpa. With this, Hua Dai started living with this strange girl...

works.title: Lü Bu De Rensheng Moni Qi
works.synopsis: Take the prettiest women, ride the fastest horse, and wield the sharpest weapon. One rider stopped the 18 armies of the Guandong lords. One man at the gate held back ten thousand. In a world of chaos, all the heroes bowed to him. People say that as long as Lü Bu lived, the world will never know peace. I laugh at those hypocrites, as I see no heroes here but I. Being caught in a life simulator, I lived a thousand incarnations in an instant. Having seeing and done it all, I have been reforged. Can this Lü Bu survive his fated doom at Baimenlou? (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Zhima Yu Mi Gao
works.synopsis: Sesame saves Rice Cake in the park, and they part ways. Rice Cake saves Sesame in the park, and this time, they become friends after Rice Cake's owner takes in Sesame. They become friends, but will that friendship progress to something more? Oh, and they're cats.

works.title: Indebted Desires
works.synopsis: Riley has always known his feelings for his step-uncle Blake are unusual. Enchanted by Blake's charms, Riley's infatuation shatters and melds with overwhelming guilt when his parents cold-bloodedly scrape every penny from Blake, leaving him wounded and broken. The pain of betrayal distances them for years until Riley joins Blake's talent agency, swearing to make it big in showbiz to repay everything his family owes. (Source: Webcomics) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

works.title: Master, Please Slay the Demons
works.synopsis: In the vast human realm, spanning nine heavens and ten earths, happily cultivating in a world full of wonders. When Chu Liang opened his eyes, he discovered that he had become a disciple of the Shushan Sect, bearing the powerful relic Qiyi Pagoda. From then on, he embarked on an adventure he could never have imagined. As the morning mist rises over the thirty-six peaks, he's already slaying dragons eight thousand miles away! "Please, Young Master, help slay the demons!" (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Desharow Merman
works.synopsis: Desharow, a student of marine biology, goes on a research voyage with his mentor Rhein to study the merfolk. In the waters off Iceland, they manage to capture a mysterious black-tailed merman. This terrifying and fascinating creature quickly captivates the research-obsessed Desharow. Unbeknownst to him, he has long been marked as prey… (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Shadow Hack
works.synopsis: By chance, Li Yunmu found a supercomputer from humanity’s dark ages. After that, his pathetic life would never be the same! Aptitude? Talent? Who needs those? I have neither aptitude nor talent, but my shadow can keep grinding experience for me in real life even when I'm away. XP, mana, weapon mastery……. all of them could be hacked, so I'm gaining experience even while I'm asleep. (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Wo Yang Cheng Le Bingjiao Fanpai Nüdi
works.ar: 我养成了病娇反派女帝
works.synopsis: What's it like to be betrayed and executed by your own disciple?! He had to consume all of his cultivation just to be able to reincanate. In this life, he won't play the good guy anymore. Why should he be nice and help the girl? If he's going to be the villain, he's going to be evil all the way! If he's strong enough, then nothing can stop him! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: The Evening Breeze Blows
works.synopsis: A smart but decadent vagrant encountered a haughty but gentle drama king with visual impairment. Having experienced something special, they started their chaotic days of living together. Could the two not-so-perfect people support and heal each other? The evening breeze would tell you the answer... (Source: Pocket Comics) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

works.title: Reborn Empress in Blood
works.synopsis: A reborn and revenge story. This time, let me protect you! Nan Yun, daughter of a merchant, fell in love with the rebellious General Huo Mingcheng and became his Empress Consort. However, Huo Mingcheng sentenced her to death to please his new lover. The snow in June allowed Nan Yun a second chance in living her life again. She was reborn to revenge, and she’s determined to reverse her tragedy…Under her cold appearance, she was gradually touched by Yan Zechen, and the sincere affection silently grew between them when he’s protecting her in silence. It turned out that they had met each other in the previous life… (Source: Wecomics)

works.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker
works.synopsis: In Eastern History, humans and spirits exist in this world. Fox spirits have long acted as matchmakers, holding a prestigious position among spirits. In this story, the lives of a fox spirit and a man who have both rejected the idea of true love become intertwined, and their exciting adventure begins.

works.title: Kitchen Goddess and the Assassin
works.synopsis: I'm an orphan who only ever dreamt of cooking until I fell into the clutches of the Zhao Manor. Due to my perfect looks, I found myself in constant peril, but as fate would have it, this top assassin kidnappe— I mean, employed me to be his personal chef! When he first brought me to his lair, I thought, "What the heck am I doughing here?" But he's a fierce fighter who protects me from danger, and I, Willow Ye, am determined to become a master chef! We make a great pear~ You butter believe it! (Source: Tapas) Note: Chapter count includes 1 bonus chapter.

works.title: Super Keyboard Man
works.synopsis: A super keyboard, comeback life of a technology nerd. Money! Girls! I want it all! Because I have a magical keyboard!! I am the Super Keyboard Man!!!

works.title: Zhou Geng
works.synopsis: The best way for the diverse human beings who make up society to unite is to find themselves a common enemy. School is a mini-version of society, so why shouldn't the same thing happen in a classroom setting? This particular class has chosen Xiao Shang to be that common enemy. But one of its more popular students soon finds himself becoming intrigued by Shang's unapologetic, straightforward way of life.

works.title: Wo Kao Cai Ji Wan Wu Sheng Ji
works.synopsis: Soul aura awakens, fierce beasts roam the earth. Chi Mo transmigrated and awakens the technique of collecting. Collecting High level talent of time, can let time go faster or slower! Collecting great golden sun phoenix bloodline can let the body transform into the sun and scorch the earth! Collecting the talent of swordsmanship, can make one understands the concept of the sword and slice through everything! (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: Lai Zi Dìyu De Nanren
works.synopsis: The Demon Lord of the starry heavens has been reborn! I am the demon lord, the gods will be my slaves, and the immortals will be my servants! (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: My Badass CEO Daddy
works.synopsis: Four years ago, she left in despair, heart-broken. Four years later, she came back, with a kid by her side. Before she could settle down, the first thing (or man) she has to deal with is this unreasonable CEO, who cannot be greener when it comes to hitting on a girl… The moment he sees her, his whole linguistic system is reduced to four words 一"I. WANT. YOUR. SON!" Who the heck would use this type of pickup line? (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Jiang Ye
works.synopsis: One of Tang Dynasty’s ordinary soldiers, a small yet courageous boy, Ning Que, received an order to escort a carriage. He bids his farwell to Weicheng, and heads towards Chang An!

works.title: Mori Jian Shen: Wo Zhenjing Quanqiu!
works.synopsis: If mercy and kindness can’t save the world, then this time, I choose to kill—Eternal Slayer! Heavenly Lightning Slash! Sword of Annihilation! As long as you learn the most common sword skills, they can be upgraded to SSS rank?! Divine talent + forbidden skills! I’m the last spark of hope in this apocalypse!

works.title: The Summoner: Apocalypse Rewinds
works.ar: 召唤之主！当异变降临人间
works.synopsis: When the Players from beyond the stars turned the peaceful Blue Star into their personal slaughterhouse, all hope seemed lost. But the system made a fatal error, unlocking the ultimate hidden class for Lin Yuan: the Necro Hunter. He's the glitch they never saw coming—an NPC who came back from death with the power to hunt the mighty Players. The game for Blue Star's survival is about to be rewritten, and he's leading the charge with vengeance. (Source: Tappytoon)

works.title: Seeking the Flying Sword Path
works.synopsis: In this world exists demon spirits, river deities, and cultivators who seek for eternal youth. Through their mystic eye, cultivators can sense these supernatural beings. They cultivate their flying swords to slay enemies from thousands of miles away. With abilities attained through refinement, the second young master of the Qin manor, "Qin Yun" is one of those cultivators.

works.title: Mori Wei Tu
works.synopsis: The story of post-apocalyptic wasteland filled with depravity. Follow the journey of a smuggler, a ruthless and bloodthirsty man, who is widely regarded as a monster due to his demonic blood as he ventures and smuggles goods in order to survive a world where only the fittest survive.

works.title: Qiannian Zhi Lian
works.synopsis: Xing Yue came to the strange Red Mansion in search of treasure, but what awaited him was not a priceless treasure, but... (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Jing Ji Zhi Xin
works.synopsis: One day, Liu Hai unexpectedly finds a beat-up book of magic. When she tries to draw a magic circle from the book, she accidentally summons a monster girl named Chi Xiaoliu. Xiaoliu has been imprisoned to provide the source of power for the Kingdom of Chi. She had wanted to escape for a long time and finally succeeded in escaping, just as Liu Hai was drawing the magical circle in the human world… and that's how the two girls met. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Wu Ming Qishi
works.synopsis: Meet the Sun Knight, the dashing leader of the Twelve Holy Knights. With his enchanting blue eyes, shining golden hair and dazzling smile he's the epitome of perfection - the perfect representative of justice and compassion. Now meet the Sun Knight's true self - the cynical, sarcastic man who would rather be anything else than be the overbearing Sun Knight who has to speaks of the Light God in all his waking hours.

works.title: My Imperial Guard Boyfriend
works.synopsis: An imperial guard got a time travel and arrived in a little girl' home. lonely and desperate for love, she treated him as her boyfriend. but he kept in mind his unfinished task in his world and eagered to go back. he promised to come back to be with her but failed. Will they meet again? This time, let me travel through time and love you in your world... (Source: Mangatoon) Includes 8 side-stories

works.title: Her Lies
works.synopsis: Zhao Fugui is a girl who can see everyone's life score, as she struggles every day on the front line of love trying to find the perfect 100-point boy. However, little did she know that there was already someone with 100 points near her, and who's loved her deeply all this time... (Source: Bilibili, translated) Note: Chapter count includes eight bonus chapters.

works.title: Urban Leveling
works.synopsis: When a 600-hundred-year old grandmaster died from failing the lighting test, he was brought back to the modern world. A badass-turned average joe aiming to regain all his badassness, Ye Tian has just started his urban levelling. (Source: Mangatoon)

works.title: The Modern Dracula
works.synopsis: What?! Why do I have to do evil things to get stronger? What kind of system is this! I just want to be a nice, ordinary guy! (Source: AC.QQ, translated)

works.title: Kaiju Shang Jiao Taigu Xianyao, Wo Xia Huai Shengzhu
works.ar: 开局上交太古仙药，我吓坏圣主
works.synopsis: Bai Yifan has an antique ring that allows him to travel freely between the Earth and the fantasy world, and he has discovered that ordinary "plants and animals" on Earth will evolve into treasures when they are taken to the fantasy world. An apple evolves into a fruit of immortality, an egg will hatch into a phoenix, and a stray dog will become the descendant of dragons. He could even use tobacco to mind-control the enemy to his advantage! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Mo Shi Zhao Huan Kuang Chao
works.synopsis: As the blood moon rises, demons invade the earth. Wen Yu is reborn back to that apocalyptic day, and given the profession of Soul Master, with the power to summon hordes of spiritual beasts. On a post-apocalyptic Earth, he will hunt powerful monsters, experience the darkness of human betrayal, survive a hopeless war, while searching for… a faint ray of hope. (Source: Kuaikan, tanslated)

works.title: Wo Zai Difu Kai Hougong
works.synopsis: Zhang Xiao just started playing a game called "King Of The Underworld" when he suddenly died and transmigrated into the game. See how he defeats all the plots and conspiracies to become the most powerful man in the Underworld, and conquer all the women along the way! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: The Boss's Shotgun Wedding
works.synopsis: Framed by her best friend, she was abandoned by her boyfriend and got kicked out of the family by her relatives. By accident, she spent a night with this cold president. "Since you're pregnant, let's get married. I know you don't love me, and you should know that I don't love you either." A story of this loveless contractual marriage has begun... (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Half My Tyrant, Half My Baby
works.synopsis: The female lead Zhang Xiao was mistaken by Mu Ya, the daughter of Mu family, as her mother. Out of her kindness, she signed the contract with the CEO Mu Chen to be a babysitter of his daughter, thus starting her "babysitting life". Mu Chen, who was originally dedicated to his career, seemed to be gradually moved by Zhang Xiao, "I broke the contract. The penalty is my daughter and me with a payback period of a lifetime. Miss Zhang, would you accept it?" (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Asterism
works.synopsis: An indescribable force draws Weiyu and Hao together. Like two stars entwined in the same orbit, these two classmates were bound to impact each other’s lives, but Weiyu’s latest prank may cost him his closest friend. As family expectations mount, the two can't help but question if their friendship is pure or just a consequence of family business. Yet that force still pulls at them... Are they fated to be more than just friends? Or were they only meant to cross paths in the celestial expanse of life? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Diyu Bianxiang
works.synopsis: A story about a demon's life and death in the depths of hell. The life of the 13th-generation demon lord. (Source: Yiben Manhua, translated)

works.title: Arrogant CEO: Wife Hunter
works.synopsis: In the hotel, she planned to surprise her boyfriend by showing up for their fifth anniversary, but it turned out to be a nightmare in her life.A stranger happened to step into her room and her life... Several years later, as a mother of two kids, she attended an interview and found the boss resembled her son. This can’t be an illusion! (Source: Mangatoon, edited)

works.title: Mang Huang Ji
works.synopsis: In the world of Mang Huang Ji, to survive, tribes of humans have to fight against the forces of the heavens, the earth, and demons. To live long and free, the three great disasters and nine robberies sent death without regret to the immortals. Then one day, a boy named "Ji Shi" was born to the strongest tribe in Yu Ji. As a direct descendant, he bears the responsibility to protect his people, who grow to respect him. With an iron will, he begins the long journey of an immortal guardian.

works.title: Nüdi De Hougong
works.synopsis: Super sweet and super-sand sculptured female statue against the harem! I often hear: "Three princes and three princesses! Your puppets are fighting again!" The overbearing female CEO traversed to the world of female honors and woke up with seven husbands. (Source: Chinese Publisher, translated)

works.title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Second Eruption
works.synopsis: February 2000: Every personnel of Babylon Labs vanished within a single night. Overseer Otto of Schicksal dispatched a special task force to investigate the incident. No one realized that this mysterious event would quickly escalate to global proportions. (Source: Honkai Impact 3rd)

works.title: My Furry Harem Is After Me
works.ar: 绝色道侣都说吾皇体质无敌
works.synopsis: I'm just a regular guy, who has just transmigrated into the body of the Demon Lord. Now I have to breed with all sorts of monster girls to help revitalize their tribes! There's the sexy phoenix girl, the cute ferret girl, the muscular panda girl… this is going to suck me dry, maybe I'm better off going out to conquer the world instead! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: The Top Clan Leader In History
works.synopsis: Ye Wen crossed and became the lord of asect! It seems to be good, but this asect art seems to be a little weaker, and people are less... "Senior, the master said, the responsibility of revitalizing the faction will be handed over to you!" The only fellow sister said with a look: " If you can't do it, give me the position of the head!" (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Zombie World
works.synopsis: The story was told through the microscopic perspective of an ordinary family of three. From the sudden isolation at the beginning, the struggle to survive after the zombie outbreak, to breaking out of the house for survival and the oasis. It demonstrated the post-apocalyptic world, the spread of the virus, and zombies on the rampage! How could they save themselves and survive in the face of extinction? What would they go through to survive? (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Lu Ming Yan
works.synopsis: Inside the luxurious pavilion, human desires flow like water, and morals are extinguished like ashes. The courtesan Qin You receives a lady visitor, who offers her a large sum to buy her freedom. She claims that she can see the future, and she asks Qin You to come with her to help save the world. (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Yuanlai Wo Zao Jiu Wudi Le
works.synopsis: Five years after transmigrating into a fantasy world, Ye Changqing thought he could be like other isekai main characters and be blessed with powerful abilities, but it turned out he had no talent for cultivation at all. He made a living by opening a convenience store in the little village near the cultivator's sect. But one day, his store suddenly became a site revered by all the powerful cultivators. Even his watchdog turned out to be a fearsome demon lord. Ever since then, people treated him like a powerful master, a legendary figure in this world… (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Tomin in The Alien World II
works.ar: 唐寅在异界II之风国崛起
works.synopsis: Tomin, an assassin who crossed over to a different world, sat on the throne of the Wind Kingdom by virtue of his decisiveness and steadfast heart. Mysterious people showed up one after another. Let's see how Tomin, amidst all the crises and obstacles, can make the Wind Kingdom rise and unify the world! (Source: Mangatoon)

works.title: Martina Will Tame the Heroes
works.synopsis: Princess Martina of the Moran Empire met her fitting end as everyone expected, losing everything from her throne to her precious daughter Lily, a sacred guardian beast key to the empire's power. Reborn with a second chance, this former villainess faces an impossible quest: collecting kisses from heroes across her realm to protect everything she holds dear. But these heroes have their own agenda, asking to become the father of her child. Between plotting revenge and navigating messy romance, this bloodthirsty princess will stop at nothing for her daughter and revenge. (Source: Tappytoon)

works.title: My Chubby Princess
works.synopsis: She was a top agent of the twenty-first century with divine medical skills. She transmigrated into the prime minister's manor as their third daughter, an ugly woman known far and wide to be a useless loser. Who could have known? When she came back again, she became an one-of-a-kind summoner with astonishing abilities! She thought her life was about to get better. Much to her surprise, an unexpected scheming prince walking into her life... (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Breed My Dear Enemy
works.synopsis: Transmigrating into the world of the book, she became a supporting female role who died distressingly. Ain't got no that for this game! The female lead decided to kill the male lead, destroy the world and get out of here! When she faced this scrawny little boy, she just couldn't do it... What should she do? Raised up this boy as her helper? An excellent idea! But this boy didn't grow up as a righteous man as she expected! Could she restart again? (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Ze Shang Jimo Ying Huo
works.synopsis: The firefly by the water shines into the night, lonely but always heartwearming. Four teenagers meet, each with one with secrets. Trust; betrayal; an exciting youth in a colorful kaleidoscope. “Meeting you was the best thing in my life.“

works.title: Rhodes Kitchen - Tidbits
works.synopsis: This is a collection of files regarding the daily lives of Rhodes Island's operators as they relate to food. May the smells of the kitchen warm our hearts and guide us true on the road ahead. The past is gone, it's good for now. (Source: Official Website) Notes: - The Chapter count includes the two volume-bonus chapters "Shio Butter Cake to Amai Kourin" and "Daichi no Plate to Rhodes no Chief Engineer". - Rhodes Kitchen - Tidbits had a simultaneous release in both Chinese and Japanese. Although both versions got a print release announced on the respective official Arknights social media accounts after the tenth and last regular chapter, the two volumes were released in Japan on May 15th, 2023, ahead of China, where both volumes released on December 9th 2023.

works.title: I Have a New Identity Weekly
works.synopsis: He triggered the Ultimate Mega System and gained the ability to take on a new identity every week. One week he is an ordinary-looking student who's actually the president of a global conglomerate. Then he became a doctor who could cure any disease, an unstoppable assassin, a tricky hypnotist, and all sorts of overpowered characters after that. Su Xun: I just want to live an ordinary life, why is that so hard? (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Transcending the Nine Heavens
works.synopsis: Reborn for the sake of a previous life. Reborn for the sake of martial arts. Chu Yang was under attack for the sake of the Jiu Jie Sword. Our hero was trapped and outnumbered by plunderers. Unexpectedly, between life and death, he was brought back 16 years in the past. Is this fate, or a coincidence? Will Chu Yang be able to change the past?

works.title: The Lord of No Boundary
works.synopsis: Time traveling from 21st to the Nanzhou era, as a ancient immortal, Ye Chen resorted to the ancient force to defeat the troop of State of Di who was trying to kidnap the Fairy Lady of Snow Shadow. He confessed his identify to the Fairy Lady, while there was still a big secret hidden behind his flippant smile and bold behaviour. What would this be? and was it a fate that the two people should meet? (Source: Mangatoon)

works.title: Psycho
works.synopsis: In a moment of carelessness, he agrees to a "kill exchange" with a psycho. Regret and fear, followed by threats, make him realize that he has nowhere to run. He becomes attached, then addicted… and then he falls in love. He falls apart. He goes insane. Mysterious and cunning madman x ruthless straight guy. This will be dark but pure, sweet but cruel. Please enjoy their story that is about to begin... (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Xie'e Lianjin Shushi Gaobuding Ziji De Shiyanti
works.ar: 邪恶炼金术士搞不定自己的实验体
works.synopsis: "This high-risk experiment was meant to help me take over the world, not to make a waifu," Yiso glumly said, many years later. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: My Beloved Fool
works.synopsis: Jian Suiying instantly falls in love the first time he sees Li Yu, his half-brother's alluring best friend. Consumed by obsession, Jian stops at nothing to win over this icy heartthrob - but just as he thinks he's succeeded, he discovers that he's been the pawn all along. Will Jian be able to overcome the pain of betrayal? And what about Li Yu? Can these two "188" guys ever find true love amidst the tangled web of desire and deception? (Source: INKR)

works.title: Honey Catch
works.synopsis: When it comes to attracting women, Chu Lin has always had it easy. That is, until Chu Lin’s girlfriend dumps him on the same day he loses his job. Depressed about the future, a drunken Chu stumbles into the loving arms of a stranger—a man named Ziming Liang. Can a failed one-night stand really lead to a true love story? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Lingqi Fusu: Cong Liyu Jinhua Cheng Shenlong!
works.ar: 灵气复苏：从鲤鱼进化成神龙！
works.synopsis: The photographer Lin Hao was on assignment at Lintian Old Town when he was killed during an attack by the monster “ET No. 002.” But he found himself reborn as a koi fish, swimming in the Old Town's Dragon Pond. He awakens a powerful Leveling System, which promises him a chance to become a true dragon by following the system's prompts to devour pray and evolve! (Source: KuaiKan Manhua, translated)

works.title: Youyuan Jing Meng
works.synopsis: A series of full color one shot illustrations of famous Chinese folk tales. 1. Youyuan Jing Meng (游园惊梦) 2. Feng Qiu Huang (凤求凰) 3. Jianjia (蒹葭) 4. A Jing (阿菁) 5. Qiong Tu (茕兔)

works.title: Wo Zhen De Bu Xiang Dang Di Yi
works.synopsis: After multiple reincarnations and many trials, Xu Xiaowen discovered that he has been given the No. 1 Buff. No matter what he sets out to do, he always ended up as the number-one at it, but then he'd drop dead afterwards. So in this life Xu Xiaowen wished to live this life as an ordinary, useless guy, and survive until 80! But then the gods made a joke out of it, by making him an omnipotent being!? (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: YOVE
works.synopsis: A talented art student, a drama queen who gets a kick out of spending on what she likes, befriends an outgoing young model who lives a thrifty life. They grow to appreciate and learn from each other, progressing along the way. (Source: Wecomics)

works.title: Don't Play by Rules
works.synopsis: When Jiang Beiran's transmigrated into a world of cultivation with a System, he thought he had it made. But the System turned out to be a pain in the ass, full of unreasonable demands! Fine, he will just do things his own way, cultivate on his own and concentrate on survival. Ignore those rumors about a mysterious hero and his sycophants. He doesn't want anything to do with it! However, this world and this System may not turn out to be so simple… (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Zhe Hunjun De Hei Yueguang Wo Dang Ding Le
works.ar: 这昏君的黑月光我当定了
works.synopsis: Duan Weiying transmigrated into the body of a new concubine on a harem mission. Her goal was suppose to beat out all the other girls to become the Emperor's favorite. But she had no interest in some unfaithful playboy Emperor, and she was going to just go through the motions and abuse her cheats to finish her assignment. That was until she found out the Emperor was actually a cool, beautiful Empress, who fell in love with Duan Weiying at first sight. Now both are caught up in each other… (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: Only Love
works.synopsis: After falling to her death at the hands of her stepsister, Shu Lan, Meng Ting wakes up in her second year of high school. In this life, all she wants is to help out her loving stepfather, fix her poor eyesight, and avoid Jiang Ren, the delinquent young prince of the country’s most prominent real estate company, who threw her previous life into chaos. But while Shu Lan is the one infatuated with Jiang Ren, it’s Meng Ting who seems to catch this bad boy’s attention... (Source: Tappytoon)

works.title: The Strongest Male Lead in History
works.synopsis: Despite being born with extraordinary powers, Zhao Xiaotian suffered many hardships. After an explosion, he followed the popular trend and transmigrated to another world. But even there dark forces would not let him go. Faced with assassinations, kidnappings, and murder attempts, Zhao Xiaotian was fed up. So he joined the most powerful cultivation sect — Xiaoyaomen. Follow his path of cultivation to the peak of power! (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: My Master Is a Deity
works.synopsis: Having been dumped by his girlfriend, Yang Yiyun found a precious treasure called the Universe Vessel in his moment of despair. He received the guidance of a Deity and took his first step on the path of cultivation. Medical skill, martial arts, divine techniques… He's skilled in all of them! A proud and cold president of a company, a rich businesswoman, a single mother, a gorgeous policewoman… All of them are at his side! This is the tale of a nobody who cultivates to godhood! (Source: WebComics)

works.title: No Arguing With Mr. Mo
works.synopsis: Xiao Nuo, better known as Secretary Xiao, is the dedicated and hardworking secretary of Mo Yanchuan. Mo Yanchuan, better known as President Mo, is the cold and aloof president and heir of Mo Electronics Group. Constantly being scrutinized and nitpicked at, Secetary Xiao is convinced that President Mo hates his guts. Little does he know, however, that President Mo's feelings towards him are not what he thinks they are at all. In fact, they may be even more than he lets on... (Source: POCKET COMICS)

works.title: Shi Lian Qiyuan
works.synopsis: The glutton Xia Meng went out to buy a midnight snack and got into a car accident which transported her into the body of a maid in another world! And so, her life of romance, cuisine, ​and adventure officially began!

works.title: Yi Ke Zhichi
works.synopsis: The unspeakable secrets between a handsome dentist and his patient's classmate.

works.title: Lord of Catastrophe
works.synopsis: Known in his high school as "Calamity", the "Lord of Catastrophe" Lin Xiongchen is a high school kid who's been bogged down by bad luck for most of his life. Because he is known to "attract bad luck to those who get close to him", he is ostracised by his classmates, which leads to him mastering the incredible ability of reflection which helps him evade all forms of danger. In a situation both thanks to fate and sheer coincidence, Lin Xiongchen finds himself possessed by a Demonic Lute one day. However, the curse of bad luck is simply too overwhelming, even for the demon. In order to survive, the Demonic Lute has no choice but to teach Xiongchen ways to turn the wheel of fate around to his benefit. (Source: Bilibili)

works.title: Against the Heavenly Lords
works.synopsis: Death to those that harm my family! Death to the ones that stole my woman! Most of all, death to the ones that dare take me for a fool! After ten thousand lifetimes of perdition, Tan Yun finally recalled his true self-- the moment I awaken, the world shall tremble before me! (Source: Bilibili Comics) Note: Chapter count includes the prologue.

works.title: Untouchable
works.synopsis: A bad boy on the outside with a kind heart underneath. A rich and cold genius with family issues. Two opposite worlds collide and form a bond that lasts. “Untouchable” shows high school love can be much more than just meets the eyes. (Source: INKR)

works.title: The Invincible Warlord
works.synopsis: Mucifer Zhan was kicked out of his family with his mother and sister by his father. Not long after, his mother was framed and forced to commit suicide. Just when Mucifer seemed to have lost all his hope for life, a mysterious man showed up and took him to the army. With hatred burning in his heart, he grew from an ordinary soldier to a ruthless warlord. Now, he's revisiting his home city and vows to retaliate those who wronged him, the hard way! (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Hei Ye Qing Wen Wo
works.synopsis: Clark, a vampire who had been sleeping for 800 years, was dug out by the young Taoist Jiang Lai and successfully bound to a contract. Trying to find a way to kill this vampire, Jiang Lai starts living with her and tries various methods, but she ends up falling for Clark's seductive charm. A chance encounter turns out to be an inevitable reunion… In that past life and in this one, the one who hated her is reborn. Love and hate are like the two sides of the moon. "Clark, come to me." (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: My Special One
works.synopsis: When Ru Yun Yum sees Hao Yue at a university concert, she is enchanted by her style and admires the girl for being so “cool”. But after night, Hao Yue disappears without a trace. Three years have passed and they meet again, now as roommates. What does the future hold for them? (Source: yman.ga)

works.title: Shaonü Qianxian: Renxing Zhi Ge
works.ar: 少女前线 - 人形之歌
works.synopsis: In the year 2030, the Beilan Island Incident causes global land contamination and severely reduces the world population. In response to shortages in manpower, humanity creates Autonomous Dolls: highly advanced androids with superior strength and advanced AI capable of expressing emotions. Furthermore, during World War 3 (2045 to 2051), PMCs (private military companies) develop Tactical Dolls: Autonomous Dolls with the ability to fight. Acquiring great wealth from the war, these companies become the de facto police and military of many nations. During this era of waning government power, Tactical Dolls of Sangvis Ferri (the world's largest PMC) suddenly kill their human masters and attack nearby human settlements. In response, Grifon & Kryuger PMC and their Tactical Dolls are hired to stop and contain the Sangvis Ferri forces.

works.title: Roulette World
works.synopsis: The moment his heart stops beating, Ye Zhongming goes back to the afternoon ten years ago when the catastrophe began. Is God showing mercy to him? Or is it another punishment for him? Does he really have to experience the terrible end of the world again? Ye Zhongming decides to fight to survive, not for anything else, but for his comrades who fought with him and the love who never abandoned him! What’s more, he wants to find the answers. Why did countless roulettes fall from the sky for no reason? Who turned this beautiful blue planet into a ruin filled with broken bodies and blood?! (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Pixiu's Eatery, No Way Out
works.synopsis: When the old demon Pixiu went out to take out the trash, he ended up with a male ghost falling into his lap. This male ghost had flawless features and had an incredibly low body temperature, which made him the perfect bolster for Pixiu who struggled with a natural curse of an unbearably hot body. Pixiu swore to the heavens that he would only use this ghost as a bolster, nothing more! Yet nobody believed him. He would go on to declare, "Even though the strings of fate have been tied on me, I will remain single." Pixiu often said that as long as he sorted his trash well, a good wife shouldn't be far as well. This comic is also named: I went dumpster diving for a wife (not). (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: The Girl of the Black Lotus
works.synopsis: I just had to be a keyboard warrior…! I read a sucky novel and wrote a scathing online review only to then find myself in the body of the story’s most despicable side character, the third female lead. Not only do I need to destroy the relationship between the main pair, but I’m on a mission to charm this bad-boy demon hunter, known as “The Black Lotus,” to complete my quest. We couldn’t be more different, but I’ll use every tactic I can to claim his love. I’m the one with the book in my hands after all, so this should be easy… right? (Source: Tapas) Note: Includes nine extras chapters.

works.title: Daoist Magician From Another World
works.synopsis: On the cusp of attaining godhood, Daolin Zhang is slain by his enemies. However, it’s not his end since he is reborn, not just as another person, but in an entire new world! Instead of qi, spirit techniques, and martial arts, he awakens as Klay Draconic, a young boy in a realm of elves, dwarves, and sorcery. Klay masters this new type of magic in no time, and his quest for power earns him fame and enemies. Good thing he has a lifetime of experience to stay one step ahead of his foes! (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Wo De Meimei Laizi Linguo
works.synopsis: Dad remarried suddenly, and Huo Tianlin, a high school student with a fierce appearance, got two more sisters from Japan! However, these two unexpected sisters have amazing secrets! How will Huo Tianlin get along with them? And how will two girls treat Huo Tianlin? (Source: Manga Toon)

works.title: The Eternal Kingdom
works.synopsis: On a seemingly uneventful day, the sky suddenly cracked, and countless monsters fell from the sky. With his innate Yin-Yang eyes, Yi Tianxing, the hero, survived the "seven-day apocalypse" with his sister and his teammates on Earth difficultly. Then thousands of planets appeared out of nowhere, and they began to merge with the Earth, forming a giant planet. Then the Earth started a new chapter called the Eternal Kingdom. (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: My Guardian Angel
works.synopsis: William and Mattie were childhood sweethearts. Whenever William got into trouble, Mattie was there to protect him. They grew up together and, together, they were inseparable. Then…the car accident happened. Mattie died. When she came back as William's guardian angel, they were together again. But…it hasn’t exactly been so heavenly. Every time William approaches a girl, Mattie “protects him,” aka sabotages any attempt at romance. Now, William can’t help but wonder if she is his guardian angel or a personal devil. (Source: Tapas) Note: Originally serialized in Manhuahui (漫画会) with 56 chapters in total. A 107 chapter long-strip version is available through foreign licenses.

works.title: Antidote
works.synopsis: Cheng Ke quit his job, moved away from his rich family in pursuit of arts. He is a sand painter who creates stunning pieces of art using sand. He becomes Jiang Yu Duo’s tenant who’s a gang leader and takes care of his sister’s apartments. Their worlds collide as they move from mutual rejection to mutual understanding. Through hard work and struggles, they each achieve success and move towards a better future.

works.title: My Junior Sisters Are Obsessed with Me
works.ar: 反派大师兄，师妹们全是病娇
works.synopsis: Lin Xiao transmigrated into the body of the villainous prefect of the Qinglan Sect! If he follows the original storyline and plays the role of the nasty villain properly, he'll be able to ascend to immortality! So he teases the junior girl, drugs the bathwater of a second girl, and steals the clothes of a third girl, just trying to do his job as the bad guy. Until finally the main character Ye Chen shows up and joins the sect! Now he just has to try to poison Ye Chen, get caught by the girls, and be punished by the main character! However things didn't go the way he expected… (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Invincible Divine Dragon System
works.synopsis: Tian Ling, a persecuted young man from his clan classmate, decided to get rid of him in a tragic way that led to death. At the moment of death his blood awakened the remains of a dragon millions of years ago known as the dragon system, he revived it in order to achieve their revenge in destroying the gods and become the supreme master ... in a training journey to seek to destroy the heavens!

works.title: Live Happily Ever After With My Ex's Uncle
works.ar: 分手后和前任的小叔HE了
works.synopsis: Sylvia's past life was marked with nothing but relentless torture at the hands of her adoptive sister and husband. Regressed back to the moment she decided to take the fall for her evil sister's crimes, Sylvia is now resolute to reverse all the terrible decisions that left her in such abusive and toxic relationships. And it's at that moment she has a steamy run in with her ex's uncle! (Source: Tapas) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

works.title: Da Jian Shen
works.synopsis: Fang Haotian is a young boy who is deeply in love with a girl called Ningyu, but her parents are opposed to their relationship. Ningyu is arranged for marriage to another man. Can he become strong enough to take back his beloved Ningyu from this man?

works.title: The Merman's Dilemma
works.synopsis: White lion, the tactical commander and pace-setter mermaid, they are the experimental body of the research institute before. They depended on each other but they used each other too. Because of a misunderstanding, the white lion was injured by the mermaid, and said that the next meeting would be revenge. But the next time they meet, he can do nothing but protect his mermaid... (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Bloodline of Dragon
works.synopsis: In the Jiulong Continent, warriors are held in high regard, and their "bloodlines" determine their achievements. The most powerful one is absolutely the dragon's bloodline! Jiang Ting was bullied by his sect for his low bloodline grade. With the help of his ancestors, he worked hard to reinforce the bloodline and promote his martial arts. He swore that he would give everyone who looked down on him a slap in the face! (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Adventure With a Magic Cup
works.synopsis: Chen Guang, a bankrupt child of a nouveau riche family, has been drawn into quite the splendid life. His best friend, the prettiest girl in school, an immortal celebrity, a despotic and attractive policewoman, a sexy coach, the rebellious daughter of a rich family, a shy female neighbor, and a childhood sweetheart. One by one, these beautiful women ruthlessly broke into Chen Guang's fate. All of this just because he so happened to pick up a fiberglass cup.

works.title: Partners in Crime, Partners in Love
works.synopsis: When medical examiner Yarra Lin meets detective Kelsey Song, what starts as a fiery clash between them gradually turns into a deep connection and partnership. Together, they bear witness to the lives of a host of ordinary people: an innocent girl who died unjustly, an elderly mother waiting in the mountains for her criminal son to return, a timid rookie cop who risked his life to confront an armed robber... They fight for justice for the living and give a voice to the dead, uncovering countless hidden truths along the way. (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Strongest Primitive
works.synopsis: This is a different primitive world with shape-shifting Smilodons and “Kung Fu pandas”. When the night falls, the glowing totem pillars are the only light source for the tribe. As a senior engineer, Cinder Fire is amazed by the primitive people who dominate both the sky and the earth. But he wouldn’t panic, for he’s going to be the strongest primitive. Let the ancestral fire be awoken, for the glory of the tribe! (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: A Beauty, A Fatal Concubine
works.synopsis: Rebirth and come back, Mu Yunyao believes in three points: firstly, don't be kind to others; secondly, remove out the source of the trouble; thirdly, don't believe the true feelings. So, she is ruthless and unscrupulous. Instead of enduring, she would rather stir the world upside down. But after a encounter, there is always a cold prince following her and wanting to marry her... (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: My Campus' Guardian of Beauties
works.synopsis: “Beautiful students, sisters, and teachers all find themselves allured to an ordinary young boy” Beautiful students, sisters, and teachers all find themselves allured to an ordinary young boy, whose life changed entirely after a mystical pen blessed him with otherworldly powers. (Source: Comikey)

works.title: Zhi Zun Shen Mo
