works.synopsis: From the top of martial art world to the trash after being in the top of martial art world in a young age he died Because of alcohol then he reincarnated into a body that can’t even practice martial arts but with his knowledge he will never give up. (Source: QQ, translated)

works.title: Xiao Chou Dan Ni
works.synopsis: A sudden plague ravaged the earth. A small town has magically escaped from the plague. In this town there is a boy named Danny, who's an orphan born with birthmarks in the shape of 'eyes with tears'. On a rainy day, a carriage brings a guest in this town, the respected artist Oreno. And so they met ... Earned Shueisha Tezuka Award and a Golden Dragon Award.

works.title: My Great Sword
works.synopsis: This is a story of a man who is cursed to live a life of solitude! Whether the ladies be eight or eighty years old, his cursed ability would affect them. Even the slightest of skin contact would cause any woman to fall into an uncontrollable state of lust and desire. Thus our hero, Sun Lang, journeys through this word in search of a way to lift his curse. He swears upon his life, that before he dies, he will regain the ability to innocently help an old lady cross the road! (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: The Foodie Next Door
works.synopsis: Qiaofeng has always been single, and there are three problems that he cannot overcome: the first, being extremely handsome; the second, being fantastically rich; and the third, owning faultlessly high IQ. Legend has it that Qiaofeng has a very abnormal IQ test paper. And anyone who wants to be his girlfriend must get at least 60 points. However, perfectly avoiding all the correct answers and marking 0 in ten minutes, she actually becomes Qiaofeng's girlfriend... how does this happen... (Source: WebComics)

works.title: What To Do! I Have Become The Weakest Little Monster
works.ar: 怎么办！我穿越成了最弱小野怪
works.synopsis: “Azure" is a popular online game that has been active for ten years running. I'm a veteran who's been playing since launch, and I got a huge prize! After opening the gift... I was transmigrated into the game as the weakest little monster! (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Rendao Da Sheng
works.synopsis: Lu Ye was reborn as a young disciple of a certain sect, but unexpectedly the sect was destroyed and he became a hard-working miner. After Lu Ye accidentally awakened the talent tree, he became a cultivator, changing destiny and stirring up the situation in the land of Kyushu. (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Social Cat
works.synopsis: School delinquent Li Miaoyu wakes up one day to find he has turned into a cute pink cat! ♂ Underneath him is Peng Yu, his handsome classmate. Unable to escape, Li Miaoyu is forced to become a "house cat". He never would have imagined this seemingly nice "owner" is actually a cat maniac, hanging around him every day with bad intentions! (Source: Kuaikan, translated) Note: Chapter count includes seven extras.

works.title: I’m the Girl With the Hacks!
works.synopsis: I finally confessed to a stud and was about to usher in some sweet love in my life, but I got electrocuted and teleported into a world of immortal cultivation?! But thanks to my hacks, I've turned from zero to hero. Not only do I have to bring my senior brothers to fight monsters and level up, I have to deal with all these distractions all day too. It's not easy being a pretty lady! So, which senior should I pick for tonight? I gotta think about it... (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Wo Du​zi Cheng Shen
works.synopsis: Three years ago, he harvested a spirit-boosting fruit, but was snatched away by a disciple guardian. Three years later, that disciple became the shining star prodigy in the sect. On the other hand, he discovered that the spiritual fruit was less than one-ten-thousandth the power of the new skill he acquired by chance. And now, he will rise up like a comet, carving a legendary path across the heavens! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: A Star Reborn: The Queen's Return
works.synopsis: She was the Queen of Song, but she died during her greatest years. After she was reincarnated, she became a simple trainee. Did she lose her former glory? It doesn't matter—no one can compete with her beautiful singer's voice. She's mocked for her lowly birth? It doesn't matter—her true identity is enough to make the whole world tremble. Does she owe huge debts? It doesn't matter... A powerful boss whispered to her: "The debt will disappear if you would become my woman." But she is proud: "I'm sorry. I would sell my art, but not my whole self." This is the story of the Queen of Song, of her return to the peak... and an overbearing chairman. (Source: WebNovel)

works.title: Return for Revenge
works.synopsis: When Empress Sawol was pregnant with the Emperor's child, she loses all of her loved ones and then is sentenced to death by the Emperor and her little sister, who became the imperial consort. After her death, she magically gets another chance to relive her life. Will Sawol do the right thing when faced with her past mistakes and save herself and her family? And will she be able to take on revenge against the malicious Emperor and her sister? (Source: Lezhin US) Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

works.title: Reincarnation of the Businesswoman at School
works.synopsis: She was originally a puppet of her family, a business spy, and an assassin that the police were pursuing. Then, she was betrayed and fell into the deep sea. When she opened her eyes once more, she had become a normal high school student in her third year. Because of her disgraceful birth, her relatives ostracized her since she was young, while her classmates bullied her because of her low self-esteem and withdrawn nature. After her reincarnation, she became a domineering person and beat those people when they bullied her again. Others had to gamble or rely on their luck to see if a jade was valuable. However, with a powerful cheat in her hands, the Spiritual Jade Vision, she could easily detect spiritual qi in pieces of jade with one glance! Life was comfortable, but there were jealous people all around her, and her skin crawled with every move they made! (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Dragon Boys' Love Affairs
works.synopsis: What? Need to have dragon babies with each other so that we can go back to heaven? But we're all male!!! (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: After I Left You
works.synopsis: Xu Lingxin lost his eyesight because of an accident. However, his partner of seven years, Lu Tianqi, didn't seem to care at all. "Let's break up, then." After leaving Lu Tianqi and finding his way through living alone in the dark, Xu Lingxin thought he was already used to being by himself. So why does Lu Tianqi seem unwilling to let go, as if trying to get him back? Meanwhile, his physician, Dr. Qin, wants to take this chance to get closer... With strong contenders on both sides, what will Xu Lingxin do? (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Fatal Scents
works.synopsis: Su Mu, male singer, gentle as water, is now paired with the dominative president Ning Ye of a large business group. The marking of pheromone puts both men’s life at stake. However, the former boyfriend of Su Mu just came back from Germany, turning from a poor actor to an award-winning one. The love from two different men is overwhelming Su Mu. Is he going to get stuck in the middle? (Source: Wecomics)

works.title: Chromosome 47
works.synopsis: When he woke up, the whole world changed. Now, it is the end of the world, and the former rich, star, and high officials were all returned to be nobody. A canned meat can be exchanged for a beautiful female star who once hit the country. This is a world talking by fist… (Source: Mangatoon)

works.title: The Bestselling Empress
works.synopsis: At the age of 20, she graduated from a top school in the United States with double major. At 23, she bought a new villa for her parents. She, Wei Yujin, had risen from the mud to the peak of fame in the 21st century, and she's going to do the same in ancient China. (Source: WeComics)

works.title: Pheromone Impossible
works.synopsis: Peach-pheromone Luo Zhiyu and tangerine-pheromone Xiao Yan have had an ongoing feud since they were 3 years old. The both of them have a 0% pheromone match, yet they’re always together. When they graduated, they finally realized that they were blinded by their scientism… (Source: Bilibili Comics) Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 5 extras.

works.title: Since the Red Moon Appeared
works.synopsis: When the red moon rose up into the sky, the world went mad. Except for me! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Lian Ai Rang Wo You Le Chao Neng Li
works.synopsis: Art student Zhong Shenxiu runs into a problem during a portrait sketching class. She couldn't "truly see" Xu Ke, a top student and the subject of the portrait session… She can't draw her subject if she can't see her clearly. Zhong Shenxiu puts down her pencil and wonders, maybe if she became a better student, she would be able to get closer to her, right? And if she could get closer to her, then she could truly see her, right? Until she gets so close that the distance between them is almost zero — like they're almost face-to-face. Phew! Now she can truly see her clearly! But! This is... a little too close! Help! What should she do now!!! (Source: Bilibili, translated) Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

works.title: She Yao Yao Chu Tao
works.synopsis: Due to an unexpected mishap, the Snake Demon King was forced into a bonded contract with a (perverted) prodigal Taoist priest. This is the story about how the Snake Demon King tries to undo the contract and take back his throne, only to lose his heart in the process. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Shenyi Qi Nü: Gui Di De Yu Shou Kuang Fei
works.ar: 神医弃女：鬼帝的驭兽狂妃
works.synopsis: The Young Lady of the Ye Clan, once a simpleton, was not fated to die by accident but then restarted her life. She inherited the knowledge of poison and medicine and conquered the amazing ancient animals. The only surprise was The King of Ghost feared by the world, that gentle and warmhearted hostage.

works.title: Gui Ling
works.synopsis: An unknown virus broke out worldwide, degenerating humanity. Andy Biya had unfortunately died from the sudden disaster, but he unexpectedly awakened the power of reincarnation and even met Eno Edison, a proud and aloof person who exuded a dangerous aura. Following the fateful experience of birth and death with Eno, the both of them gradually learn the secrets of each other and the world. (Source: Kuaikan, translated) Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 7 extras.

works.title: Genius Teacher System
works.synopsis: Ning Fan died, but unexpectedly, he traveled to another world and became a teacher with superpowers. He was supposed to be a genius teacher of S level, but something unforeseeable happened to his family. Framed by backstabbers, his family was knocked off the pedestal, so he was assigned to the worst class--D Class. Fortunately, he still had the Genius Teacher System. Let's see how he could conquer students, prove wrong of the villain, take the academy, set up new sects, stand on top of the this world, and finally achieve counterattack under hopeless situation. (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Continued Love
works.synopsis: After enduring a long period of resentment and coldness from his partner, Cheng Jin decides to let him go following their bankruptcy. However, destiny intervenes when his lover suddenly loses his memories and falls in love with Cheng Jin once again. Although Cheng Jin is overjoyed, he is also anguished as he anxiously awaits the arrival of the inevitable “limited time” for their love. (Source: INKR)

works.title: Fanpai Xiang Yao Duo Huo Yi Tian
works.synopsis: One day, Linghu Qiang suddenly acquired the "Villain's Revenge" system and began his new life as an isekai villain. His mission is to survive the story, claim his rewards, and return to his original world. But being a villain is no easy task. Sometimes, the protagonist would lock on to him right away and take him out. Other times, some mighty swordmaster would cut him down before he even did anything evil. In short, his success rate… kinda depends on his villainous skills. (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: My Billionaire Life: Just a Playboy
works.ar: 我一个神豪，当渣男很合理吧
works.synopsis: Caleb wakes up reborn... with a Tycoon System. Every second that passes, his wealth increases-automatically. As the system levels up, his fortune explodes at an insane rate. Status, power, influence-everything starts coming to him. After a lifetime of regret and restraint, he makes one decision-this time, he plays by no rules. If fate is handing him everything...he's going to enjoy every second of it. (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Sealed with Lips
works.synopsis: Before she was reborn, she was bullied by her step mother and her scoundrel sister together, and even became a her sister’s tool of fame who ended in dying in the hospital bed. After she made her comeback from the hell, she tortured her step mother and punished her evil sister. In her previous life, she was driven anguished and desperate by her indifferent fiance, but after she was reborn, she issued an annulment of her engagement with that man! However, she was directly forced to the corner ——Wanna pull back? It’s too late! (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Bloodivores
works.synopsis: Vampires have been defeated by Humans. A story about them wearing collars. Wait - you're mistaken, it's not like that!

works.title: Forensic Princess
works.synopsis: A 21st century forensic doctor somehow traveled back to ancient China and became a princess. What’s better is her first treatment was rather intimate (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Almight Network
works.synopsis: When Fang Lin bought a new smart phone, he found out the phone app gave him a special social network with the immortals. In a dog eat dog world, Lin is taking a stairway to heaven with this special social network. (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Dragon King's Son-in-law
works.synopsis: After swallowing a "mint" by accident, he became the designated son-in-law of the dragon king, who is also the big boss of a corporate group. His fiancée turned out to be quite hot-tempered. Meanwhile, the dragon elders have their eyes on him, lurking. Their world is turning out to be rather dangerous... (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Betrayal of Shadow
works.synopsis: Saal Cooper was the perfect "shadow" of the Cooper family. He was loyal, powerful, and... expendable. Spellbound to be Eren Cooper's human shield, Saal took all the wounds and pain meant for his master, making him an invincible hero. When the family discards him like a broken tool, Saal discovers the horrifying truth behind his lifelong agony. Betrayed and left to die, he reverses the spell with his final breath, reclaiming his stolen power. But death grants him an unexpected gift when he is reborn as his three-year-old self. This time, Saal is determined not to live in the shadows. (Source: Tappytoon)

works.title: Bossy Wife’s A Little Cold
works.synopsis: For the sake of her family, she became his wife. But right after they got married, he told her “I made you my wife, but I will never give you my heart.” A few years later, she returned with a demeanor cold as ice, and she brought along a young child that looked just like him, which got his heart all flustered. Will his new feelings fluster her, too? (Source: Dongmanshe, translated)

works.title: Wo Zhaohuan Chu Le Zhu Tian Shen Mo
works.synopsis: Qin Jun was just an overworked corporate slave, until he transmigrated into the body of a deposed prince. But at least he was blessed with the Legend Summoning System. He can summon any character from legend to command! See the mighty Wukong shake the mountain with one strike of his staff, while seeing and hearing all with his powers! The Buddha himself can hold the world in the palm of his hand, and no one can escape! In this fantastical world of gods and demons, see how Qin Jun becomes the most powerful emperor of all! (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: Moshi Nüyou: Wo Jia Houyuan Tong Moshi
works.ar: 末世女友：我家后院通末世
works.synopsis: Song Chao found a ring that allowed him to freely travel between our world and a post-apocalyptic world. In the post-apocalyptic world, food was more valuable than gold, and there wasn't much left in that world except for gold! Song Chao has found the way to make it big! He took a tomato from his refrigerator at home and sold it for ten kilos of gold in the other world! You can even exchange food for beautiful women! You really think you can do whatever you want when you can offer food after the apocalypse? Yep, as long as you can offer food, you really can do whatever you want! (Source: iQiyi, translated)

works.title: What Do You Do When You Suddenly Become An Immortal?
works.synopsis: When you transmigrate to another world, someone from another world is transmigrating into you. One day Lin Fan found himself swapping bodies with a saintess from another world. Whats more, they can swap back and forth as much as they want! This is the start of their messy, confusing isekai cultivation adventure! "Excuse me, so what is your name…?" (Source: Tencent, translated) Note: Chapter count includes an extra chapter.

works.title: Enraptured by Your Radiance
works.synopsis: Two young men exist worlds apart, yet in a chance encounter, talented ballet dancer Shu Yun meets Tong Yang, a rising star of the Peking Opera. One of them is an accomplished son of a distinguished family with too many secrets, and the other, a diamond in the rough down on his luck… Somehow, they manage to find hope and light within each other. As their paths cross and intertwine, how will their lives change? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Full Marks Hidden Marriage: Pick Up a Son, Get a Free Husband
works.synopsis: After five years, Ning Xi has returned and is out to take revenge on the sister who turned her parents against her, and the childhood sweetheart who betrayed her for her sister. She aims to fulfil her childhood dream and become a famous actress. However, her sister is still out to get her and she has to avoid all her underhanded schemes. One day, after falling into one of her sisters' schemes, she meets an adorable kid and saves him. This was how Ning Xi found herself staying at the mute little kid's house to help him come out of his shell. Slowly, his father Lu Tingxiao starts falling for her too. (Source: WeComics) Note: Season 1 was completed on 2021-11-28. Season 2 started on 2022-10-21.

works.title: A World of Their Own
works.synopsis: Slaying demons and finding love. A marriage alliance between two great demon-slaying families brings Mo Yan and Xuan Yuanyu together. Though it was only suppose to be a marriage of convenience for two years, he soon discovers she has come to occupy a place in his heart. Will they be able to stay together amid endless conflict and hidden truths? (Source: Manta)

works.title: Super Swordsman
works.synopsis: On the Sky Spirit Continent, martial power is most honored. In this world, the strong wander between earth and sky and are able to terrorize, destroy and shake the world! Lin Chen, a young martial arts master from the modern world, came to this magic world with a mysterious tiny caldron by accident and became an outer disciple of the Celestial Sect in the Yannan Region. Let’s see how he suffered plenty of tribulations and reached the Nine Skies before becoming the best and growing into the Super Swordsman! (Source: WeComics)

works.title: I Awaken as A World-Ending Behemoth
works.ar: 我化身魔神，成为灭世巨兽！
works.synopsis: In a time when Impure Creatures rampage across the Earth, entire cities face massacre and destruction, and the very fate of humanity hangs in the balance, Isaac Aurelio steps forward. After cultivating in secret with the support of a reptilian Avatar more terrifying than Godzilla, Isaac and his black Behemoth face this onslaught of existential threats head-on, becoming the only force with the power to strike fear into the otherworldly evil that threatens their world. (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Wo Keyi Xiugai Wan Wu Shijian Xian
works.ar: 我可以修改万物时间线
works.synopsis: What should I do with these expired elixirs? Don’t worry, I can revert it back in time, so give me all of your expired elixirs! What should I do if my cultivation process is too slow? Don’t worry, I'll just shift the cultivation time forwards by about five years, so it'll look like I mastered the cultivation technique right away. What if I get hurt? Don't worry, I'll just revert time back to my body's healthy state, before I got hurt. What happens if I transmigrate to a new world as a weakling? Don't worry! I can change the timeline of everything! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: When the Stars Align
works.synopsis: Yogurt is an Alpha, and Cookie is an Omega who just moved to be Yogurt’s neighbor. Out of curiosity, Cookie wanted to find his brother, and was harassed by other Alphas on the street. Luckily Yogurt arrived in time and helped him, which, as a result, made them closer. What will happen next between them? (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Straight or Not
works.synopsis: He is a sunny, hilarious, positive and obscure actor. He is a composed, generous and graceful general manager. Because of a strange request, they began a long journey of attracting each other. What should they do? Nonsense, of course becoming lovers. (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Psychomachia
works.synopsis: After Ming Shu finished his training and returned to Dongye City’s Criminal Investigation Bureau, he found that Xiao Yu'an, his old neighbor who was like a big brother to him that left without saying goodbye many years ago, had suddenly become his immediate superior. What was crazier was that they also became housemates and started living together! While Ming Shu juggled that headache of a situation, mysterious murder cases followed one after another - an unemployed man suddenly going crazy in a book cafe, the most hardworking performer of a Chinese orchestra dying strangely, an escape room game that seemed to be more than a game... Ming Shu, ‘This time, I won’t let you go.’ (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: God of War
works.synopsis: Within the Nine Prefectures, there are many kingdoms. Rumor has it that deep in the desolate lands, masters are as common as the clouds. They have the ability to go against their fates! Outside the Savage Beast Mountain Range, in a small city called Stone City, there is only one person who goes against the will of the heavens and changes his fate. (Source: Managtoon)

works.title: Transmigrated as an Omega Who Snags His Alpha
works.synopsis: Quinton Lewis was once a ruthless mafia boss until a fatal gunshot ended his life. When he reopens his eyes, he wakes up in a stranger's bed, dressed in lingerie. Acting on instinct, Quinton attempts to attack the stranger only to uncover a shocking truth: he's transmigrated into an omegaverse world as a pampered Omega and the stranger turns out to be his supposed Alpha lover, Cain Lloyd. Trapped in a body and role he never chose, Quinton must navigate power, desire, and danger once again. (Source: Tappytoon)

works.title: Sweetheart V5: The Boss Is Too Kind!
works.synopsis: Jing Yiren was a proud and talented 14-year-old princess. One night, she was transmigrated, and she became the 19-year-old wife of Lu Conglomeration's President. This sudden change would test every fiber of her being! For his part, Lu Ming now has to deal with a wife who is wholly confused by her new station in life. In the face of such problems, he can only get through to her with his actions. (Source: WebNovel)

works.title: Flowers in the Secret Place
works.synopsis: To find her best friend who was caught by ghosts, a girl sneaked into the world of ghosts and provoked the quirky prince of ghosts, there is actually smell of her missing friend on him? ! What’s the relationship between him and the girl? The secret hidden in the world of ghosts is about to be revealed... (Source: Webcomics) Note: Includes the prologue and 15 extras chapters.

works.title: Duo Sha Wo Ji Ci, Wo Jiu Wu Di Le
works.ar: 多杀我几次，我就无敌了
works.synopsis: Summoned into a world where the divine and martial arts coexisted, Qiao Mu can revive infinitely while leveling up. The more tragic his death, the stronger he gets when he revives. His enemies are shocked when they realize after defeating a boy, another man up, without end! Rumors started to spread about the legendary Qiao family… Wait, no one told me that every revival makes me older! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Infinity Mailman
works.synopsis: A package from Hell, along with a mysterious stamp album, opens up a whole new world. Please sign for your package and embark on a thrilling journey. Mailmen come and go while stamps last forever. (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: The Deserted Woman
works.synopsis: She fell into the nasty plot of her sister and was humiliated. After many twists and turns, the misunderstandings passed by, one by one... When all the truth was revealed, when the plot was punctured, what would be their destiny?

works.title: Bitten to Reign
works.synopsis: My King, why was I being put to the sword? If everything could start over, would my knight protect me until the end once again? Even if I was born only to be punished by God, even though I knew that my fate was written in the stars, I still couldn't stop myself from falling deeply in love with the world, the sunlight, the desserts, the King, the dresses, and my beloved knight. (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Mojiao Jiaozhu Gou Zai Wo Shen Bian Kan Wo Tou Tou Xiulian
works.ar: 魔教教主苟在我身边看我偷偷修炼
works.synopsis: Sold to the Nineth Nether Demon Hall as a child, He Yun grew up safely thanks to his honesty, hard work, and culinary skills. However, in the middle of an ordinary day, in broad daylight, he was forced to "XX" by the sect's leader! (Source: Tencent Comics, translated)

works.title: Shenwei Shoufu De Wo Zhen Buxiang Chongsheng A
works.ar: 身为首富的我真不想重生啊
works.synopsis: Humans that wear clothing with ancient elements, knights that use elemental magic, cultivators that soar through the sky on their swords, a loli squad who fights using nanomachines, undeads who came from a door to another world, Super Saiyans... These all aren't important, what's important is: "Do you want to become rich"? Top of the realms! Strongest in the universe! Earning the name of the richest man alive in Forbes! Taking you on journeys around the realms! Teach you how to be the richest! Teaching you how to achieve financial freedom! Earn an astronomically large sum of money!!

works.title: My Babes Are My Wingmen!
works.synopsis: A cunning agent, a bossy president, and heart-melting twins. How will the story unfold? Years ago, An Jiujiu was set up by her step sister and slept with a man. The one night stand ruined her reputation but left her a baby. She thought she could raise the child and live her life in peace. But a mission brings her and Ji Jinchen, the most powerful man of City Jiang, together. To her great surprise, his son looks exactly like hers... Aug & Pudding: Since mom and dad don't know how to date, we are the only two who can help them! (Source: Mangatoon)

works.title: Liming You Xingchen
works.synopsis: A funny but dramatic story about the growing romantic relationship between Li Ziming and Xin Cheng.

works.title: Adonis Next Door
works.synopsis: Su Shuang Shuang comes home one day to find that someone has moved into the apartment next to hers. When curiosity gets the best of her and she goes in to meet her neighbour, a handsome guys comes out of the shower? And he calls the police?

works.title: Devil to Healer
works.synopsis: "Wanna sign a contract with me to become that destined one?" Devil Jekaterina is summoned and saved by a cultivator girl Yuchi Yue. To Yue surprise, the first thing Jekaterina wants to do when she wakes up is to ask her sign a contract with her with a kiss? "Kissing on the lips is the thing that can only be done between those who likes each other!", Yue shouts and refused. But it seems that Jekaterina doesn't understand what does she mean... (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Ni Shi Wo De Mingyun
works.synopsis: Yuan Bao, a sweet hardworking girl and Zhao Qingwen, a genius girl with high coldness, got married because of taekwondo. The two of them are like Mozart who is dazzling talented and Salieri who is inferior to Mozart, attracking and repelling each other, and gradually developed a deep bond from the initial disgust of two things. Just when the feelings are quietly budding, the successive changes have caused them to fall into unpredictable distress...

works.title: Gu Fang Bu Zi Shang
works.synopsis: Bai Pingting has always been unable to believe the saying "a woman's virture is ignorance". She is a maid of Jing Anwang, but she lives even better than some wealthly women. She is also wiser than most men and she hopes for a higher intellect. Even if that man is an enemy, both are full of lies and conspiracies. She is not fond of that man. But between a choice the love and loyalty, she will begin to think that she isn't as meaningful as she once thought she was...

works.title: All Strings Attached
works.synopsis: Comic artist Xiaoge Fang needs a lawyer, some smooth-talking hotshot who can sue his publishers for all they’re worth. That’s what they get for trying to screw him out of royalties, but… easier said than done for someone with an empty bank account. Enter Mo Qian, an attorney with a record almost as perfect as his looks. His offer? In exchange for representation, pretend to be his boyfriend to make his ex jealous. There's no way Xiaoge will accept. He’s not that desperate... right? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Subdue My "Villain" Hubby
works.ar: 我成了反派大佬的小娇妻？！
works.synopsis: The dainty idol Chen Congong unluckily fell into a trap and awoke to a stunning naked man in her bed! Hahaha, I don't mind ending up with such a beautiful man? Hang on... Are you telling me I've switched places with the toxic, evil, and manipulative side character who won’t even survive 20% of the plot?! No, I'm definitely not ready to die!! Watch as I keep on living my ideal life! (Source: QQ, translated)

works.title: Working Overtime to Destroy the World!
works.synopsis: Limbo is a shut-in girl who doesn't care for anything except her tentacle comics. Aside from that, everything else is meaningless. On her birthday she wished for the "destruction of the world" and was instead met with a demonic female programmer! The two instantly hit it off, bonding over their common goal of world destruction, the two "project partners" hustle hard everyday to bring the world to an end with hilarious effect. (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Invest In Me
works.synopsis: A schemer may never know how pure or how devoting that love can be. I may be dominating or calculating; I may lie or cheat. But the only reason behind it all is that I love you more... (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: You Are My Lovely Dragon King
works.synopsis: “Can't you see?! Dragons really do exist!” He's a gorgeous white dragon hiding in plain sight. She's a genius med student who started college at 12. Now, she's a super cynical 18-year-old grad student. One day, a man faints in the town square, and she runs to his rescue. Pointing to the nearest person, she grabs help from our very own white dragon, instructing him as he performs CPR and saves the stranger's life. A random chance meeting becomes a full-on meet-cute when they end up sharing a table with each other at a packed diner that very same day! What happens when the fate of a skeptical genius gets tied up with a mystical dragon?? Will sparks take flight, or will this romance make a crash landing? (Source: Comikey media)

works.title: Li Min Di Guo
works.synopsis: Fan Li accidentally found a wormhole that could travel through to the medieval world, where there were pastoral songs, but also wars and chaos. You can gather a harem of wives and concubines, or you can fight to dominate the world. But no matter kind of goal you want to achieve, you must start by making money. (Source: QQ, translated)

works.title: Biancheng Ke Xi Chushou Guai Hou, Tamen Geng Fengkuangle!
works.ar: 变成克系触手怪后，她们更疯狂了!
works.synopsis: For unknown reasons, Xiao Zheng would transform into a tentacle monster when he became excited. Even if he longed for love, he would disguise himself as being cold. But suddenly he was summoned by Bai Anan, who was usually serious but secretly loved drawing. He signed an agreement and became Bai Anan’s “familiar”. He was threatened to help her – to draw the Manhua that would top the list! (Source: Bilibli Comics, translated)

works.title: Fanpai: Bei Tou Ting Xinsheng Hou, Nv Zhu Xiang Dang Wo Hougong!?
works.ar: 反派：被偷听心声后，女主想当我后宫！？
works.synopsis: Tang Yu transmigrated into the world of an urban novel as its rich heir villain. He was just going along with the plot, trying to enjoy life as a rich playboy, when the female characters all heard his private thoughts about the situation! Now all of them have broken character to come on to him! Hey, I'm just trying to make it through the story until the happy ending! Help! (Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)

works.title: Stop It, Mr.Wolf
works.synopsis: The overbearing president who is the black wolf king invaded my house, tries to eat me day and night and he also said want to marry me?! The world of beast is too hard to understand! If I really can’t oppose of it, I can also secretly enjoy it right? (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Fei Ren Zai
works.synopsis: Chinese mythical beasts living in modern China.

works.title: Xuan Huan: Kai Ju Jiu Ge Xiannü Shifu
works.ar: 玄幻：开局九个仙女师傅
works.synopsis: When Ye Xiu was reborn, he was given the talent of the Heaven's Eye. Any new skill he learns is maxed out right away! "What, you spend thousands of years cultivating the Nine-Turn Invincible Sword technique? Sorry, one look and I'm already max-level at it." "Phoenix Fire? Zhuque Flame? Dragon Soul? All mine with one glance!" "What? You say you're the strongest in the universe? Sorry, I've got nine immortal ladies teaching me all their techniques." Of heaven and earth, who is the most powerful? Ye Xiu: "That would be me!" (Source: Bilibili, trnalsated)

works.title: Born to Be a God
works.synopsis: You dare look down upon me? I'm gonna kill you! You dare touch my girls? I'm gonna make you sleep forever. In this continent, strength is the rule, and the most powerful is highly respected. A legendary talent is reborn, and the Taiyi Superb Water can make me powerful enough to shake this world. I'm Saint Ling Feng, but unfortunately, I was reborn as a trash after drinking Taiyi Super Water. But after years of hard cultivation, I finally become the best Alchemy Master with the help of Taiyi Super Water. (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: The Star of Ashes
works.synopsis: The princess of Trailblazer Kingdom lost everything to internal strife. By a twist of fate, she was taken in by refugees from the very nation that destroyed her home, and forced to survive on enemy soil. Behind her lies blood and vengeance. Before her stands warmth, love… and a place to belong. Torn between revenge and redemption, she struggles to choose. But when love rekindles her faith, she decides to stop running. She will fight for the people she loves and pave a true path to redemption! (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Entangled with the Duke
works.synopsis: Not only did I wake up in a coffin, I even became a 'man'! did I have a time travel? What’s with this man’s dress? The life in another world is not easy, and I even have to deal with that dark and cunning duke! (Source: Manga Toon)

works.title: Dachengqi Cai You Nixi Xitong
works.synopsis: Jiang Li, after crossing over, discovered that he possessed no special abilities, so he had no choice but to diligently cultivate. Five hundred years later, he finally became the strongest man in the Nine Provinces. Suddenly, a System appeared, offering to help him to go from a beginning cultivator to becoming the strongest in the Nine Provinces. Jiang Li stared incredulously at the System's first mission: “Defeat your cousin (sixth-level cultivator).” “This System is running a little late, isn't it?” (Source: Tencent Comics, translated)

works.title: Chronos Ruler
works.synopsis: The story centers on "Chronos Rulers," those who fight the time-eating demons that appear when people wish they could turn back time. The Chronos Rulers fight a time-manipulation battle against these demons. (Source: Anime News Network)

works.title: I'm My Own Girlfriend
works.synopsis: What would happen if you were your own girlfriend? One night, Luo Yuchen gained the ability to transform into a beautiful girl. As he was adjusting to his newfound power, the mysterious girl who caused all this chaos finally showed up! Now, his day to day life has become a complete mess! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Seal Me 900 Million Times!
works.synopsis: Wei Daduo, a genius boy born in the Divine Realm, has always been a headache of the immortals because he can't control his divine power at all! In that case, the Divine Realm would be devastated by Wei Daduo's fart or sneeze one day... That's ridiculous!!! The immortals can't bear it anymore! They want Wei Daduo's power sealed! Unexpectedly, Wei Daduo seals himself millions of times because he has been dreaming about worldly life and he also plans to start over as an ordinary cultivator in order to fully master his power... So his worldly life begins... with two runaway girls of an unknown sect! (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Wo de Luoli Didi
works.synopsis: "It feels TERRIBLE to have a brother!"- we both thought. Until one day, we both made a wish to turn the other into a sister...

works.title: Demon Realm: Can't Wait to Quit!
works.ar: 再不死我就统治魔界了
works.synopsis: In a brutal battle against the demons to reclaim their territory, humanity’s strongest warrior, Arthur King, is killed at the final moment when he is caught in the Demon King’s blast, only to be reborn as one of them through a mysterious system. Due to a system error, he has no choice but to die again to return to the human world. He throws himself into deadly situations, but fate twists against him, and every attempt at self-destruction pulls him deeper into the demon world. (Source: Tapas)

works.title: White Throne of Bones
works.synopsis: Young Bai accidentally kills someone, from then on he enters the world of killers. A black card appeared in front of the door of pale throne, who can get the ultimate weapon left by the the most successful killer? To kill, to follow the road of killing, is it also the road to finding oneself.

works.title: The Pinnacle
works.synopsis: “I set a goal for myself when I was fifteen: to become the strongest martial artist.” Jia Fugui is the undefeated master and esteemed leader of the Muye School. But despite his achievements and proven strength, he is extremely insecure about being bald. Follow Jia Fugui and his second in command in their hilarious, yet fierce search for a cure. (Source: Comikey)

works.title: The Fairy Captivity
works.synopsis: A dystopian fantasy. In this futuristic world, humans are ruled over by faeries. The young master Yue Hu encounters the fairy Fei Liai, and gradually uncovers the truth and dark secrets behind them.

works.title: The Beautiful Seventeen
works.synopsis: Feng Nian, timid and bashful, had a crush on Gu Shaoqing, the class president. While gradually getting attracted by Feng Nian, Gu Shaoqing, shy and vulnerable, didn't reject Feng Nian or respond to his love after detecting his feelings. With the help of their classmate, Wang Ling, Feng Nian tried to confess his love for Gu Shaoqing. Unexpectedly, Feng Nian's possessive brother, Feng Zewen, tried all possible means to prevent them from being together... Will their story blossom? (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: I Blocked the Demon King's Ultimate Attack, and Ended Up Becoming the Little Hero's Full-Time Nanny!
works.ar: 挡下魔王必杀技的我，居然成为了小勇者的专职保姆
works.synopsis: The eccentric party of the "Strongest Middle-Aged Meat Shield" and the "Weakest DPS Little Hero" partner up to grind their enemies to death! With their strong survivability, they lead a comfortable dream life in another world where everyone is out for themselves! (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Tower into the Clouds
works.synopsis: If you're a man, then you should be able to reach the 100th level. Mao Li, the main character, begins his ridiculous journey in ascending the tower. Will he be able to reach the 100th level?

works.title: The Demon Blades
works.synopsis: The demon blades came out and broke the quiet life of the world. An ordinary boy got a chance to become a swordsman and eventually save the world. (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Dong Qu Xia Lai
works.synopsis: An American girl who has educated herself on Japan has moved to the country with the culture she loves so much. She even joins a Japanese high school, which she is late to on her first day. A fellow Japanese classmate shows her a way in and soon the two girls become friends and perhaps even more.

works.title: The Devil Ring
works.synopsis: A college freshman, Zhou Xiaoan, accidentally puts on a ring of unknown origin from the Shang Dynasty and spits out a horrible blood zombie from his mouth. A secret in the history of mankind is unveiled… (Source: WeComics)

works.title: Ex-wife of A Billionaire
works.synopsis: Married for two years, Jian Mo held the title of legal wife and bed warmer for Gu Beichen, and even handled his scandals once in a while. She had to keep him satisfied in bed and at the same time, deal with the mistresses who came up to cause trouble… All of this had become a habit, but one day, she suddenly heard this sentence from him: Jian Mo, let’s get divorced. (Source: Wutopia Comics) Note: Chapter count includes eight extras chapters.

works.title: Du Zhuansheng Le, Wo Cai Buyao Zai Gei Ni Bumo!
works.ar: 都转生了，我才不要再给你补魔！
works.synopsis: In her past life, she wore shackles for her. In this life, she received a wedding ring from her. "I'll be the one to take care of you this lifetime!" A wolfkin princess reborn from the flames x a reincarnated saint bound by her destiny... A forbidden love story that renews across time and space! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Chao Xia
works.synopsis: After her parents divorced, Lu Yang lived at her mother's best friend's house and lived with her daughter, Su Gui. Su Gui, bright and gentle, like the warm winter sun, easily illuminated Lu Yang's life, but also her heart. Lu Yang looked at her, like a sister, like a friend... Later, Lu Yang didn't want to be her sister, she wanted to be with her. But after discovering that her feelings for Su Gui had deteriorated, Lu Yang did not want to break the harmony of the moment, and even more afraid of losing her "sister" identity, she could only tolerate dependence and move away from Su Gui. However, after reuniting with Su Gui because of her work, the feelings she had been suppressing grew wildly, like branches of roses, wrapping herself and Su Gui tightly. Is it a long-planned plan or is it fate? (source: Billibilli, translated)

works.title: The Trapped Beast
works.synopsis: With his back against the wall, Crispin Tadelville, the last surviving alpha of the Tadelville family, disguised himself as an omega to escape death. Now, forced to bide his time as a plaything for the Ethelanian nobles who slayed his people, Crispin waits for the perfect opportunity to exact his revenge. His only obstacle? The prince of the Ethelanian empire he seems to have mistakenly marked. (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Go! Magic Lord!
works.synopsis: Once upon a time, the Magic Lord started a war with humans, and the Three Great Sages fought against the Magic Lord arduously. One of the Great Sages even sacrificed himself to seal the Magic Lord... 800 years later, when an apprentice sorcerer named Salamander was having the Advancement Test, he accidentally released the hypnotizing gas. Later, it turned out that his pet snake, Fu, can turn itself into a human! Fu took Salamander and ran away from the test. After hearing the news, the Senior Mage who adopted Salamander couldn’t take it any longer. The Senior Mage seems to have an irresistible reason to break the rules for Salamander and promote him to the Grade 1, Star Class. (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: The Heiress vs Young Ruffian
works.synopsis: Bad luck! My dad kicked me out of the house! Then revenge a playboy whose grandfather was a gangster! That's not all! I go to the noble school to be the maid of four demons... (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: I’ve Gone Viral Thanks to My Crush
works.synopsis: Yu Bei has had a crush on Gu Yiming for 8 years and he is always there for Gu as his good "bro", only to find out the gossip between Gu and an actress. So, Yu decides to give up the secret love and he swears not to sleep with Gu anymore! But the obtuse straight man Gu Yiming seems to notice something suddenly! What will happen to Yu Bei after all these years? (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Shiyi Lu
works.synopsis: Fragments tells the independent stories of Li Chang Ge, Ashina Sun, Situ Langlang and Mo Ying. It is aimed to help readers enter the delicate inner world of each character, showing the unknown past and richer personalities of the characters.

works.title: Nitian Zhan Shen
works.synopsis: Hundred years ago, a generation of God of War Ye Qingyun was born, crushing the sons of various great figures, making the enemy frightened by the wind, but unexpectedly betrayed by his lover Luo Ling, brother wolf thirteen, and falling into the Devil Abyss! A hundred years later, all walks of life entered the golden age, and wicked characters emerged wildly! Ye Qingyun was reborn as a waste disciple of the Ye Family, a small family in the Eight Desolate Continent! Fate is reversed and fate is changed! In this life, I will not only crush the genius, but also kill all those who bear me! A ruthless sword, a dragon slaying knife, kill everything, unify the gods, dominate all things!

works.title: Lime Herbal Tea
works.synopsis: Gu Gu, a shy girl, meets Xing Xing, an extroverted basketball girl. Xing Xing is everything Gu Gu wants to be - have lots of friends and live a happy, carefree life with dreams. Gu Gu is organized; she lists out a long to-do list for herself. But how does that help her get closer to Xing Xing? Wait, maybe Xing Xing is trying to get closer to Gu Gu too... (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Wo Shi Da Huan Dan
works.synopsis: A masterful pill was born at the top of the Peak of Not Returning. It is Yushu who is in the wind, is chic and suave, has a broad mind...I! Yes, it's me! Beat and beat, eat. (Source: AC.QQ, translated)

works.title: Girls, Magic, and Cultivators
works.synopsis: 5000 years ago, the demonic sect led a great army to battle the cultivators. After years of battle, the demons destroyed all the cultivator sects. The world changed drastically after the war. Other professions such as mages, knights, and healers started to appear. This world became a world of magic. 5000 years later, a bolt of lightning reawakened the cultivator Zhong Tianshun, who had been hibernating in the Xuanyuan Forest. He is now the last cultivator in the world. (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Lang Xiaojie He Ta De Huli Meimei
works.ar: 狼小姐和她的狐狸妹妹
works.synopsis: The setting is a modern world populated with beast-people, ruled by the law of the jungle. Twenty-year-old Yu Wenxi is a wolf-woman who stands at the top of the food chain. She fought her way to the top with her bare hands with a fierce attitude and no respect for the weak. Until one day, when her stepsister dumped a fox cub on her. From then on, the wild wolf turned into a gentle guard dog. She vowed to raise the crybaby cub to become a good student and a good citizen! However, the fox-girl's good-girl appearance hides a dark side. Little Fox: "Sister, I've been a good girl, can you… do something nice for me?" (Blinking back tears) Now that the crybaby fox cub is all grown up, her first order of business is to find and capture the gray wolf that abandoned her. She'll chain that wolf to her territory, and never let her escape… (Source: Bilibili, translated) Note: Includes five extras.

works.title: Legend Reboot
works.synopsis: His goal is only one, the world champion! (Source: WeComics)

works.title: Bu Zhi Bixia Shi Nülang
works.synopsis: The new emperor, Qi Nian, acceded to the throne many years ago. He kept refusing the requests by his officials to choose a consort, brushing them off by saying "I am busy with work. The affairs of state are more important." But Qi Nian finally relented as rumors that "the emperor is impotent" began to spread. Yu Dingdang is a rather dim-witted girl, but born to a prestigious family. This led many to say: "Miss Yu exchanged her brain for her looks". Nobody expected that she would be chosen by the emperor to be his empress consort? Yu Dingdang acted surprised on the outside, "Who? What? Me?" But inside she was thrilled, because she has wanted to become Qi Nian's bride ever since she was little. When she successfully marries her crush, that is when a slapstick comedy breaks out in the palace, when she finds out that the haughty emperor is actually a woman?! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: 37.5℃ Hidden Love
works.synopsis: Growing up together, they’ve been the best friends all the time, and this is also the attitude they hold toward their relationship at the very beginning. As a result... none of them declares their love to each other even if there is bidirectional crush between them. Being the most troublesome emotion, secret crush enables one to do everything that only lovers will do, makes he grow complex feelings, and also enjoys the carnival alone... He is afraid that his confession might be laughed at, and he is even more scared that a confession would put an end to their original relationship. Both of them overreach themselves in their first love which is full of ignorance, a superficially breathtaking but actually sweet love story! (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Lengku de Wo
works.synopsis: As a zombie with memory loss, school life is still a must! While fighting with his instinctive hunger for humans, he also falls in love with his destined one. But it seems like not only does his lover know how he became a zombie, but he was also a schemer behind the scenes. In this SM danmei, the truth of the zombie gradually emerges. (Source: Kuaikan, translated) Note: Includes a prologue.

works.title: Chief of the Novice Village
works.synopsis: I was a perfectly fine necromancer, so how have I ended up becoming the chief of novice village? But, since it's all set in stone, I'll just build a village that has a harem filled with beautiful young girls! Do you have a problem with that? I didn't think so! Let's begin the parallel world's novice village (harem) from scratch... (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Wang You: Wo Neng Jinghua Yiqie
works.synopsis: Betrayed by his best friend, our protagonist loses everything: billions in wealth, his loved ones, and even his legs. In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.

works.title: Be A Monk in Japan
works.synopsis: My name is He Xun, a Taoist from China. Due to an accident, my soul traveled in space to Japan. Now I live in the body of a high school student in Japan. Although I still have my cultivation, it is far from the one in full bloom. When I looked into the reason for the accident, I became a classmate with a six-tailed fox spirit. Moreover, currently, she lives in my house... (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Death Field
works.synopsis: Slender Man, Mothman, the Butcher, Cecil Hotel, the Slit-Mouthed Woman, Hanako of the Toilet, the Non-existent Stairs of the 13th floor, the Cat-faced Granny, Bus 330, Jack The Ripper… Welcome, travelers, to the world of 999 strange tales - the spirit world. (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Return of the Avenger
works.synopsis: “Forbearing from revenge for years, this time, he must seize what he has lost!” After witnessing the murder of his parents, Ye Qing Yu kept his promise to guard their graves while cultivating rigorously for the whole of four years. Ye Qing Yu subsequently makes it into Bailu Academy, the most prestigious martial arts academy, with his talents and cultivation. He goes on to prove those who look down on him wrong and take vengeance on his parents' killer. (Source: Comikey)

works.title: Xiuzhen Kuang Shao
works.synopsis: Ye Qian treated like a fool, abandoned by his family, bullied by his classmates, and looked down by the world. Until one day when he awakened the memories of a previous life as a powerful immortal cultivator. With this newfound knowledge and power, he will rise up and have his way with his school, and then go out and take over the city! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: A Record Of A Mortal's Journey To Immortality—Immortal World Arc
works.synopsis: 10,000 years after the time of "A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality," in the Spirit realm, the fox girl Liu Le'er's clan was wiped out by the Blood Saber sect, and she was being hunted down herself. Suffering from multiple injuries, Liu Le'er hid under a rock, just when the three pursuing cultivators were about to cut her down, the rock suddenly burst open, and an ordinary-looking man emerges from inside... (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Zhan Long
works.synopsis: Li Xao Yao left S.W.A.T to become an ordinary security guard, while working, he happened to enter the VIP room and found Lin Wan Er still in the middle of changing, as revenge, she took him on a ride and kicked him out of the car, after hours of walking, Li Xao Yao finally managed to get back home just to be kicked out of the house. He then got an offer from his previous supervisor to become the bodyguard of the Tian Xi group ceo's daughter both in game and in reality. But unknown to Li Xao Yao the girl was actually... (Source: OSTNT)

works.title: Dolo's Destiny Capsule
works.synopsis: Jana’s a talented artist, but she’s also an awkward high school girl. When her first love Conrad transfers to her school, she’s over the moon until this popular genius very publicly denies knowing her. Before she dies from the online shaming, the mysterious creature Dolo has just the thing for her — a capsule to change her destiny! All it requires in exchange is something valuable to her. What will Jana sacrifice to make her dreams come true? Nothing could go wrong… right? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Wo Chong Sheng Cheng Wei Wangzi Dianxia De Xiao E Long
works.ar: 我重生成为王子殿下的小恶龙
works.synopsis: I, Bian Yurong, had lived 18 peaceful years with good grades as a college student and making good money as a game streamer, when I was randomly killed by some criminal. What's worse, I'm reincarnated into my favorite game as its endgame boss, the black dragon! I know how the game goes, so I'm going to take charge of my own fate! But wait, the crown prince who's been taking care of me, something's not right with him? (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Holding Onto Him
works.synopsis: She sinned for the beloved man and was jailed for five years. Five years later she came out of jail and he greeted her not his proposal but a betray with her sister. Desperated and helpless, she met the richest man in City A... (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Cang Tian Zai Xia
works.synopsis: Zhou Mingyu, a college student who possesses the bizarre power called Tiangou became targeted by various powerful forces in the warlock world. To free himself from Tiangou's influence and to find the truth of his father’s death, a mysterious incident that happened more than a hundred years ago in Kunlun Mountain will be unveiled…. (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Huli Zong Shi Zai Shuo Huang
works.synopsis: Tang Ran is a sunny and cheerful little fox spirit. In order to graduate from youkai school, she transformed into a college student to try to seduce a human. However, what she didn't know was that Su Qingci, the cool lady professor she had her eyes on, was actually…? One lie begets more lies, as each girl tries to seduce the other, that is the way of the "lying" fox. (Source: Billibilli, translated)

works.title: The Ex
works.synopsis: Love is a war. A war where no blood is shed, but can leave you countless scars. An ugly girl who was cheated on receives a mysterious phone call one day. The caller says that she is the 35-year-old herself from the future- she wants to teach her the art of love! Now she is on the road to become a better version of herself, take revenge on her ex, and reclaim everything she once had! (Source: Copin Comics)

works.title: Private Doctor
works.synopsis: They mock me for being a bumpkin from the mountain, but I win the hearts of their goddesses with Miao medical practices... (Source: WeComics)

works.title: Dragon Raja I
works.synopsis: Lu Mingfei never expected to live an extraordinary life. He was content with his average achievements and took pride in his skill in Starcraft. However, all that is upended when he suddenly receives a scholarship to study in Chicago at a place called Cassell College. It all seems too good to be true, this can only be a scam! Little does he know, that when he does eventually accept the offer, it is but the beginning of the rest of his life, and the college's obscurity will be the least of his concerns once they start telling him about the dragons... (Source: Webnovel) Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

works.title: I Rely On My Harem To Conquer The World
works.synopsis: Li Haoran, once a brave youth who fell to his teammates’ betrayal in a brutal battle against strange beasts, awakens to a shocking new life, reborn as Blood Demon King in a hidden village teeming with alluring succubi. Gifted with a twisted system that fuels his power through building a vast harem, Haoran vows to seize this second chance. He will forge himself into an unstoppable demon lord, gather his bewitching companions, and lead his harem to conquer the entire world. (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Wanmei Beihairen
works.synopsis: "The person who is destined to be the perfect lover is secretly a murderous devil?! There are many secrets to the widowed mother. The life of Qiqi is completely changed by a mysterious stalker."

works.title: Wo Kao Qianpozheng Shang Wangzhe
works.synopsis: The high school boy Yin Yongtian suffered from a strong case of OCD. He got on the wrong side of a bully when his OCD caused the bully's proposal to go wrong. He was almost beaten to death, but the trauma activated his Compulsive System! Yin Yongtian wasn't actually all that interested in cultivation, but the System kept tempting him with missions like ”Unanswered Notifications", “Almost Acquired Proficiency," and “Extremely Irregular Hexagonal Panels,” which triggered his compulsion to finish them and become stronger! With skills more than a hundred times more powerful than regular people, he and his friends will venture into the dungeons, and his compulsions will set him on the pathway to becoming the strongest. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Shadow System: Harnessing Shadow Power Become the Ultimate Hunter
works.ar: 异狱暴君：我的影子能无限进化
works.synopsis: In a world overrun by alien invasions, only one in a thousand can awaken as a Vanguard. Burdened by debt and left behind by society, Li Yi survives at the very bottom until a brutal attack leaves him on the verge of death. There, he awakens the Shadow System. With an endlessly evolving shadow at his command, Li Yi finally gains the strength to fight back and carve out a future in a world that never gave him a chance. (Source: Tappytoon)

works.title: Divine Path to Supremacy
works.synopsis: This is a world where anyone can have the chance to become a god. Choose the path of thunder, one can become a Thunder God. Choose the path of the mountain, one can become a Mountain God. After becoming a god, you can create your own divine kingdom. Lai Cang transmigrated into this world with no money and no talent to take on the path to becoming a god. But after a lucky accident, he found himself with a divine kingdom of his own, despite never completing the path to godhood! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Defective Lovers
works.synopsis: The short-tempered captain of the criminal brigade, Qian Cuo, and the sophisticated cold-blooded detective, Teng Ruiyu, had been partners in breaking countless queer cases. But two years ago, they were involved in serial crimes related to soothsaying art... (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Dao Yin
works.synopsis: Jiang Xiaofan accidentally traveled to a different dimension and ended up as a beggar. He never had a chance to practice martial arts previously, but he accidentally obtained fragments of Dao Yin and inherited its secret moves. This is a journey of our hero in this trouble-filled new world!!

works.title: Childe and Sweet Wife
works.synopsis: He is a dumb and paraplegic child abandoned by his family. Ignoring ridicule of others, she is his wife in their false marriage. After their marriage, she finds that he is a wolf in sheep's clothing. The ones who call him a dog always pay the price. He said, "Do you know the characters of dog? Brave, loyal and...hungry!" (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: The Strongest War God
works.synopsis: The strongest soldier and a band of ferocious heroes -- fighting for their country, fighting for their people! Only death can stop them, and they will press on until their dying breaths! (Source: Qidian)

works.title: A Merman's Affair
works.synopsis: Stunt double Yu Bei fell into a merman’s territory by accident. To stay out of trouble, she disguised herself as a princess. The merman prince, who had not seen humankind for a long time, suggested a marriage of state just so he could meet the human emperor and save his kind from exploitation. He then visited earth with Yu Bei but later fell into a trap that Yu Bei set up for him... (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Shengnü Xiaojie Qing Tingzhi Ni De Qiguai Nao Bu!
works.ar: 圣女小姐请停止你的奇怪脑补!
works.synopsis: "I, Polly the Holy Priestess, will never surrender to you, the Demon Lord. No matter how you humiliate me, whether it’s a drugs, torture, or hypnosis, just bring it on!" "I, Lucius the Demon Lord, just want change my fate as a villain and prevent my own destruction! So all of you saint, princess, elf, and valkyrie, please stop coming on to me!" (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Warm Wedding
works.synopsis: To pay the benefit, Charlotte married into Fan family. She believed that her husband is Shine Fan, who were seriously burnt and isolated in special care. But as time went on, she found that Ron Fan, the brother of Shine, are acting strangely towards her...

works.title: Dong Hai Xun Mei Ren
works.synopsis: In a past life, the mountain goddess took in a quiet child, only to find that the little one didn't want to be her servant, but instead aspired to become her intimate companion! But fate played its cruel hand, turning the once inseparable pair into bitter enemies? In this life, a cute, water-fearing mermaid happens upon an aloof beauty with no memories of her past. A chance kiss during their first meeting is just the start of their chaotic relationship. However, what had seemed to be a serendipitous meeting turns out to be a long-fated reunion with roots reaching deep into the past... From lifetimes past to present, an obsessive love flourishes... (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: The Brocaded Tale of The Girl Si
works.synopsis: Her unfortunate life began with a marriage of which the two families didn't match. Her first husband detested her for killing his first love; her second husband, despite showing great favor, only regarded her as a substitute? Now that Jiang Si has entered her new present life, she is determined to define destiny all by herself! (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Huanying lai dao Emeng Youxì
works.synopsis: Qi Leren unfortunately got a black screen when he cleared the first BE ending in "Nightmare Game". On the way on the bus to repair the computer, the bus collided with a sudden truck, and the injured passengers were taken to the hospital. When he woke up, Qi Leren found out that he was lying in the empty infusion hall, and there was no one to be seen in the huge hospital … (Source: QQ, translated)

works.title: Policing in the Zhou Dynasty
works.synopsis: Li Mu traveled to a magical world full of demons, ghosts and immortals. All he wanted at first was to be alive until the fox he had saved began to talk…This story is about a modern young man doing justice in a magical world. (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Wo Shi Zu Tianxia Wudi
works.synopsis: Ye Yun traveled through the martial arts world full of gods, devils and demons, and became the patriarch of the Divine Dragon Sect. After 100,000 years of secluded cultivation, he came out from his fraudulent tomb with god-like techniques, skills, and weapons which stunned his disciples. But one person’s invincibility will not be enough to make the world submit, it takes a strong group of people to make the world tremble! So Ye Yun will lead the Divine Dragon Sect to once again become the strongest sect, able to sweep the heavens and conquer ten thousand realms, rising up to defeat all who stand in their way! (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: Wan Zha Chao Huang Zhi Jian Fei Hen Mang
works.synopsis: Cheating Men Must Die Side Story. Su Lüxia receives a mision, smuggling into a small world to abuse scum. Her targets: the bastard Emperor and three evil consorts. However, she encounters agent Jiang Mo of the 'Male Readers Group'. In order to finish the mission given by the male readers system, Jiang Mo arrives in the small world to drive out agent Su Lüxia of the female readers system. Two agents fighting in a small world, a female readers system versus a male readers system, who will be the final victor? (Source: AC.QQ, translated)

works.title: The Mermaid I Met by Getting Fired
works.ar: 失业后我在海边遇见了人鱼小姐
works.synopsis: After the pandemic passed, our protagonist lost her job and decided to join a tour group to the seaside to relax. Only to meet a mermaid in the ocean?! The mermaid acted strangely and quickly disappeared. But the next day, she saw the mermaid again, and her jaw dropped in astonishment… (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: They Say I'm Broke
works.synopsis: The cold and aloof company president only had one goal: attack the new singer Yu Nian on Weibo and become his number one anti-fan! A few months later, he announced, "We're together." Anti-fans: ...?! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Little Raider Princess System
works.synopsis: I've reincarnated! Different from those cold-blooded murderer fathers, my father is a total slave to his daughter (me) since I am his only princess! With a Princess System, I have hack tools whenever needed! However, I never had expected... (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Wo Xi Huan Ni De Xin Xi Su
works.synopsis: As a good-looking Beta boy from a good family, Duan Jiayan's life has been smooth sailing for many years, until he runs into Lu Xingci in high school. Lu Xingci's family is richer, he's taller, he's a better basketball player, and their grades aren't even close. Even his own friends can't help but praise Lu Xingci sometimes. What's worse, that girl Duan Jiayan had set his sights on admitted that she has had a crush on Lu Xingci for years. Ever since then, Duan Jiayan has disliked Lu Xingci. But during a medical exam, he was told that he is a late-blooming Omega, and because he became an Omega so late, it came with serious side-effects. Any Alpha who comes near him will feel a painful sensation and become violent. And Duan Jiayan is allergic to the pheromones of all Alphas, all except for Lu Xingci. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Cinderella Chef
works.synopsis: I will conquer your stomach first and then conquer your mouth with my excellent cooking skills. I can always handle both evil husband and nasty mother-in-law. As for those ill-disposed sisters-in-law, just let them be jealous! I’m not going to play with you. Source: Qidian

works.title: MODE II
works.synopsis: After a merciless serial killer attacks his sister, a timid boy downloads an app that grants him superpowers: Mode II. Through the app, Shu Ye can hear the inner thoughts and feelings dwelling deep within people’s hearts. But there’s a catch and, with power…comes those who abuse it. (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Askr Yggdrasil's Wood
works.synopsis: Exiled to a desolate and harsh planet, Ayr spends his days hunting giant monsters as his food source. Then, everything changes when a police officer comes and tells him his exile was revoked. After arriving in Askr he learns that a lot of time has passed while he was gone. 100 years. Everything seems to be different now, but one question remains: For what reason was his exile revoked after this long time? (Source: INKR)

works.title: The Making of Princess
works.synopsis: Once a haughty princess, now a lowly maid! Humiliated and abused, she refused to give up in the face of a cruel and unforgiving reality. As she climbs her way back up using her unparalleled wits, will she be able to reclaim everything that was once hers? (Source: Pocket Comics) Note: Chapter count includes two bonus chapters.

works.title: Birth of a Goddess
works.synopsis: Poor Ah-Jiu led a sickly and miserable existence as the daughter of a concubine but never lost her warm and charismatic heart. Xiao Yang witnessed the tragic destruction of her little village by war but held tight to her hopes for a better tomorrow. Just as Ah-Jiu is at death's door and as Xiao Yang is on the brink of starvation, a divine messenger arrives, promising to transform them into powerful goddesses! A pair of amazing tales about two heroines that are sure to win your heart… and war! (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Change
works.synopsis: A violent and muscular boy who dreams in becoming a national champion, unexpectedly turns into a cute girl, how will she achieve her dreams?

works.title: Sweet Escape
works.synopsis: She was pushed to a man with extremely mysterious identity. After she was intimate with him, she had no choice but to run away during pregnancy. A few years later, she showed up with her son, Bao! As a little man, the biggest dream of Bao is to help his mom find a perfect husband who should be the richest man in the world with a height of 1.99 meters and 8 abs for his mother! “Mom, what do you think of this man?” added Bao，pointing his finger at the man who seemed to be a plus size version of himself. “Woman, you’ve escaped for a long time, it’s time to come back and make an apology!” The man appeared aggressively! As a result, Lin Zhi lost not only her son, but also her heart! (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Wo Shi Fei Chai
works.synopsis: Wang Yi’s only an unremarkable loser, but he actually possesses an unparalleled ability that even he did not know about. As long as any spirit monster (demon) touches his blood, they’ll be instantly annihilated! Let's see how this good-for-nothing loser becomes god! Source: Manga Updates

works.title: Supremacy of The Demon World II
works.synopsis: When an ordinary human gains the power of the demons, he will gather the most beautiful women, recruit the cutest pets, on his way to become the most powerful demon lord! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Buhui Zhen Youren Juede Xiu Xian Nan Ba
works.ar: 不会真有人觉得修仙难吧
works.synopsis: A humble rookie seeks the path to immortality — only to accidentally join a sect full of pretentious con artists. His seven senior brothers brim with confidence, taking turns spouting out fabricated divine techniques. But no one expected this newcomer to be a genius. He actually comprehends everything — even their nonsense! In the end, the master falls into despair. Just who is this junior disciple?

works.title: The Villainess’s Vendetta
works.synopsis: Yu Xiang transmigrates into a book and becomes the Marquis's unfavored sister, plagued by a disability and branded an ill-omen. Moreover, she is an imposter, left with no choice but to rely on her elder brother for protection, planning to step aside quietly once his biological sister comes home. However, when his real sister finally returns years later, the Marquis forbids her from leaving… (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Women Fanpai Cai Bu Xiang Dang Tajiaoshi
works.ar: 我们反派才不想当踏脚石
works.synopsis: A webnovel writer transmigrated into the body of Lin Xiao, a wealthy heir. He wasn't injured, he wasn't betrayed, no one looked down at him. Instead, he had a high level of cultivation, full of powerful gear and potions, and he could flaunt his wealth and power. Life should've been great! The only problem is — Lin Xiao is the villain, and the villain's job is to be a stepping stone for the chosen one, the Hero! The unfair oppression of villains in this world made him angry. Let's see how Lin Xiao will overcome the hero's fate, and make villains great again! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Dangxin Emo
works.synopsis: A small and weak bookworm gets into trouble with a domineering and handsome werewolf! "Anyone who messes with me will be punished!" sneered the werewolf. During what was supposed to be an unexciting game of punishment, unexpectedly, the completely ordinary little bookworm transforms into a handsome and alluring incubus! "You're my type, doggy." the incubus smiled wickedly.

works.title: Adorable Princess
works.ar: 天降萌宝小熊猫：萌妃来袭
works.synopsis: Thanks to King of Hell's mistake in work, I died... and was then reborn. As a token of apology, King of Hell promises to make me adored by everyone and loved by a handsome man. Well, as reincarnated as a cute panda, I am indeed adored by everyone, but that's not what I signed up for! As for the handsome man - ahhhh though I am now in my panda form it is still embarrassing to shower with you! (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: The Prince's Cactus
works.synopsis: It’s the 21st century already, and yet, there’s still someone referred to as a "Prince"!? Born to a small European country, his mother is of royalty there. His father on the other hand, heir to prosperous European shipping industry, is a descendant of Queen Victoria. Since birth, Elian has been groomed to be the crown prince, filled with natural confidence…(Then again, he could have been born this way). To put it bluntly, he’s an arrogant person. Dania, on the other hand, is a girl whose father has left her for another woman, and she has to work for a living. However, her sister gets married to Elian's father, and she attends the wedding in Greece. There she meets him for the first time...

works.title: The Lord of Swords
works.synopsis: Several centuries ago, the Saber Lord defeated the Sword Emperor, causing countless sword cultivators to lose their status. They were bullied and ridiculed, until... the birth of a certain young man, one destined to bring about change! Chu Mu was originally the adopted son of the Chu Family. Yet, after he sacrificed his saber soul to perfect his sword soul, he fell from his glorious throne. They laughed at him, betrayed him, and even his fiancee chose to leave him... But what's wrong with having a "useless" sword soul? With a determined heart, Chu Mu will do the sword soul justice, and become the most powerful being in the universe! (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Dang Shen Bu Rang
works.synopsis: Yang Jian is exiled into the human realm from the Heavens in order to repent. His former partner, The Howling Celestial Hound, has reincarnated into a young girl. Witness how a barbaric Immortal from the Heavens and his partner move 100 demons to tears.

works.title: Dominating the Immortal Cultivation Realm
works.synopsis: He thought he had it made when he transmigrated with a powerful system. But it turned out that to level up his system, he had to get beat up by other people. Just as he was resigned to accept the beatings, a young girl appeared and brashly asked him to become her apprentice. Tempted by the pretty loli, he accepted her offer. Hey, she'll grow up some day. But he didn't know she would grow up quite so quickly... (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Zhang De Tai Xiang BOSS, Jieguo Shì Ren Zhen De Xin Le.
works.ar: 长的太像BOSS，结果世人真的信了
works.synopsis: Su Liang, the King Of The Moon! Master of the Divine Lunar Butterfly, with the power to control time and space, ying and yang, the invincible young man will stand at the pinnacle of this world! So I transmigrated to this world and into this powerful body, sounds like a great start... except it's all bullshit! My familiar is no Lunar Butterfly!! It's just a low-level glow moth that can barely light up a room!!! Now I'm faced with millions of fanatical believers, a battle with the Emperor Cangyue scheduled in three years time, and all of the major sects who see me as a thorn in their eyes... This is… big trouble for a beast-master! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Villainous Diva Empress!
works.synopsis: An adaptation of Mo Ling's novel: Coming of the Villain Boss! It's said the plots of quick-transmigration systems are classified as: normal-hard-hell-goddess. Beating up white lotuses, trampling on scum men, using unpredictable means of revenge...see how a goddess makes them tremble in fear, fleeing in all directions. However this time, why is he not dodging or hiding, instead sticking to me? "Because this time, I want you to fall in love with me."

works.title: Demon God
works.synopsis: Thousands of years ago, the immortal clan and demon clan were battling for the universe. To defend the peace and justice, the immortal clan created a mysterious legendary fighter, who blew himself up into thousands of pieces, floating in the world. And Lu Xiaofei inherit a piece of the fighter. (Source: Mangatoon)

works.title: The Hunting Game
works.synopsis: "Teacher, I know your secret crush. It was my dad, wasn't it? If you want me to keep it a secret, then become my lover." That threat threw Ye Qing's life into chaos. When he was 19, Ye Qing had a crush on his private tutor. 18 years later, all those repressed feelings were revealed, and Ye Qing was forced to play a lovers game with his teacher's son. Despite their 18-year age gap, he felt powerless under the younger man's aggressive tactics. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Body Electric
works.synopsis: Ba Song is the hotshot cop who’s been handed an open-and-shut case: the suicide of a young woman. Except… who commits suicide by stabbing their own body and strangling themself?
