There's only one man who can help him with this mystery — Bo Shan, the renowned forensic pathologist with a severe and cold personality. What's more, his body produces bioelectricity, allowing him to acutely sense bodily injury with his touch. There's an electric current between them, and each touch sizzles with energy... (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Hei Yueguang Nü Zhu Zong Xiang Biaoji Wo
works.ar: 黑月光女主总想标记我
works.synopsis: A manipulative and calculating Alpha (Disguised as an Omega) × A cold-on-the-outside fearful Omega (Disguised as an Alpha)! When designer Gu Yu transmigrates into an ABO romance, she becomes the villain who will be killed by the protagonist, Su Yue. In order to survive, she decides to flatter the 'fragile Omega', creating stunning looks and helping her dominate showbiz. But Su Yue is not an Omega… she is an Alpha in disguise! And now, with intoxicating wine pheromones, she demands: 'Ready to be marked and be mine?'" (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Drop-dead Beauty
works.synopsis: The immortal heavenly emperor's daughter is reborn! Awakening in the body of a girl that's considered as trash, the immortal heavenly emperor's daughter opens her eyes to the perception of a new world. The girl once considered as a piece of trash now begins her counterattack! Along the way, she encounters a variety of beautiful men. The gears of fate start to turn. What will await along the path of cultivation for the wicked consort?

works.title: Romance of Flash Wedding
works.synopsis: He was raped by a woman in a blind date by accident. Who is he? He is a young man from a powerful family in the capital, attractive to young ladies but leading an honest and clean life. Who is she? She is a disfavored daughter in a wealthy family. He said to her, "Marry me and the marriage is your best protection." She said, "Neither will I be used by you, nor will love you." He smiled, "But I love you indeed." (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: My Young Lady Is a NEET
works.synopsis: The daughter of the Li Family has always been mysterious, and it has always been rumored that she's a prim and proper, graceful young lady. In reality, however, she is a shut-in otaku who never puts on make up nor brushes her hair, and even has social anxiety. Upon being met with an engagement from Han Group, the young university student-cum-insurance promoter Gu Yuan has been hired to transform this girl into an upper-class young lady. Can he succeed? (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: The Sword Of Dawn
works.synopsis: The main character died in a plane crash accident, he was transported to a strange spatial installation orbiting a strange alien world with a physical body, for over a hundred thousand years he observed the emergence and evolution of life and the formation and fall of civilizations until he woke up in a coffin, the story follows Gawain, the Grand Duke and a founder of the Kingdom of Ansu. (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Prince, I'm On A Diet
works.synopsis: Born into a family well-versed in Chinese medicine, Han Fei woke up one day and found herself transmigrated into another body, unable to even bend down and see her toes! And then she found out that she was headed for an arranged marriage with the prince in the wheelchair. People made fun of their handicaps. The fatty and the cripple, the ideal couple? But for the sake of his handsome face, Han Fei swore that she's going to lose weight! And have herself a grand wedding! (Source: Kuaikan, translated) Note: Includes three extras chapters.

works.title: Reincarnated as an Unlucky NPC: My Wife's Got My Back
works.ar: 穿越成倒霉NPC：我有老婆罩着
works.synopsis: He Qingyang transmigrates into his favorite game, but he takes over the body of a doomed NPC whose backstory he always skipped over in the game. All he knows that he was harassing the female lead Yu Yiwan, and when she found out, she cut him down with one stroke of her sword. Trying to change his NPC fate, he tries to finish his missions as soon as possible so he could escape. But it turns out his fate is more tied to Yu Yiwan than he realized… (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Solo Slime‘s Ascension
works.synopsis: Reincarnated into another world, but became the lowliest of all life... A slime mold! From decomposing wood to beasts to dragons, this slime mold shall one day rise and dominate! (Source: WebComics)

works.title: All My Female Disciples Want to Kill Me
works.synopsis: With memories from my life in the 21st century, I was transferred into the body of a man named Su Bei in another world and given the "10,000x Disciple Rebate" system. All my disciples are gorgeous women with amazing attributes. Any one of them could be the main character in a novel. But they all hate me so much that they want to kill me. What on earth did the original Su Bei do to his disciples in his previous life?!! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Eternal God Emperor
works.synopsis: A supreme martial artist is killed by his beloved and is reincarnated 800 years into the future. He’s reborn as Ruochen Zhang, the sickly and lowly ninth son and prince. His doting mother is the exception to a family of treacherous schemers who jockey for power and status, so it surprises everyone when Ruochen emerges as a martial arts prodigy! Determined to protect his mother and avenge her suffering, nothing will stop Ruochen from becoming the greatest martial artist in this world too! (Source: Tapas)

works.title: The Cultivator and His Contract Demon
works.synopsis: In the world of the Cloud Pact Sanctuary, magic cultivators and contract demons coexist in harmony. After being recruited by the sanctuary’s founder, the young cultivating prodigy, Xie Tong, begins his journey as a superstar among his peers. But things take an unpredictable turn! Xie’s stoic facade crumbles when he meets a weak fox demon named Zhiyi who will do anything to please him... anything but cultivate magic. Can this couple overcome their power differences to form a contract—and more importantly, a deeper bond? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: You're the Apple of My Eye
works.synopsis: Jiang Yeyu and Qiu Xi became family after Jiang's mother remarried. But when they grew up, Jiang Yeyu fell in love with his younger brother unwittingly. After a long separation, an unexpected reunion awakens the affection that Jiang Yeyu has suppressed in his heart. To protect the brotherhood or to confess his feelings, how will Jiang Yeyu choose? (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Tong Lei
works.synopsis: The abuses suffered as a child will be inflicted again as an adult. Some people will take it out on others, but some people only harm themselves. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Warden of the Demonesses
works.synopsis: The Rose Prison of Silver City was known to be the most secure and sturdiest female prison in the entire continent. The most dangerous and vicious female criminals on the continent were thrown in here, and I, Aiden, was the warden in charge of this prison. However, the original "Aiden" was a powerhouse who was adept in using guns, swords, and even black magic. I was nothing but an ordinary person who had transmigrated into his body! Did I know any of the skills mentioned above? Absolutely not. (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Return of the Reborn God Emperor
works.synopsis: In his previous life, Lin Xiao accidentally obtained the God’s Resolution Sutra and awakened the ancient ancestor body, an unparalleled overlord body. After all kinds of hardships, he eventually became an immortal and conquered the gods and demons. Now, he’s reborn and returned to his teenage, seventeen years old self…

works.title: Sheng Wang
works.synopsis: Qi is the origin of all life. Qi Gong is the origin of all cultivation. Yang Qi throw away everything for the woman he loves but in the end he was betrayed by the one he loves the most. Hunted by other aristocrats and with no home to return to. Now with his Qi Gong being destroyed he no longer has the capability to use any martial arts. However, the Heaven has yet to turn its back on him... (Source: MangaUpdates)

works.title: You Are My Only Love
works.synopsis: Ji Wanqing, an A-lister in the showbiz who doesn't care about family, love or fame but money, finds herself stuck in a dilemma after meeting Sheng Yu, an attractive popular singer. Will Wanqing, a self-proclaimed aromantic, fall for the flirty and sweet Sheng Yu? Ji Wanqing, an A-lister in the showbiz who doesn't care about family, love or fame but money, finds herself stuck in a dilemma after meeting Sheng Yu, an attractive popular singer. Will Wanqing, a self-proclaimed aromantic, fall for the flirty and sweet Sheng Yu? (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Dou Hun Dalu
works.synopsis: Trash? A good-for-nothing who can't awaken his fighting spirit? A disgrace to the Luo family name? The biggest joke in Wuling province? All of this just makes him laugh! He was spurned by his family, hated by his father, and even strangers made fun of him! Eventually, he was disowned and kicked out of the house! But losing everything caused him to become enlightened! He realized that, on the Fighting Spirit Mainland, only the strong are respected! When his former talent returned, what others saw as genius was nothing more than a joke to him. They call him a demon? He responds: "Hehe, what I, Luo Chen, love to abuse most is evil!" (Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

works.title: Bond of Beast's Desires
works.synopsis: The suspense author, Xiu Rui, personally got himself involved in tracking a case for writing his materials, but found out that the truth of the case was exactly the same as the content in his novel! And the person who was behind was lurking around him... Sin makes love grow fangs, and discrimination will eventually swallow and destroy trust. The entwined triangle relationship now begins. Who should he believe and who can he believe? (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Emperor-in-Law
works.synopsis: A normal college student is married to a rich hottie, and gets to enable a "life system." Whatever he chooses on the system will come true! Only kids make choices; adults want everything! See how the rich son-in-law counterattack on those who bully him and rise to the crown! (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Divine Realm Online
works.synopsis: Welcome to Divine Realm Online, where victory means everything. Schemes, battles, betrayals, sacrifices, this is not just a game; the price you have to pay is nowhere near what you can possibly imagine...

works.title: The Peerless Demon Emperor
works.synopsis: They call him a demon, yet his sword dominates the heavens and his power shakes the universe, transcending even the immortals! They brand him a Buddha, yet he slaughters wherever he goes, mountains of corpses piled up and rivers of blood streaming, more demonic than demon itself! Cleansing his body with blood and tempering his bones with fire, in the cycle of life and death, he becomes a great demonic lord! The young Lin Feng rises above his hardships, unexpectedly acquiring the Demonic Seed, thus becoming the only Demonic Patriarch in this universe! (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Zheng
works.synopsis: Terminally ill lad, after losing his family in an incident, found out that hidden behind the disease was an extraordinary power. While pursuing the truth behind his family death, he himself, got dragged further down the mysterious dark abyss...

works.title: The Strongest Pick-Up System
works.synopsis: Lu Dequan, a poor but hard-working college boy, was suddenly "blessed" with the power of the Flower God, along with all sorts of abilities and powers. However, until he finishes cultivating the Tome Of Romance, he must remain chaste. Any intimate contact with a woman will cause instant death. The only solution is to win the true love of different types of beauties, to help him cultivate the highest level of the Tome. Meanwhile, members of the succubus tribe are acting strangely, trying to tempt him… What adventures will our hero have, now that he controls the ultimate pickup system?! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Your Turn to Chase After Me
works.synopsis: Mo Shi Yi is a talented girl, whose dream is making a lot of money daily, marrying a handsome and rich guy, and stepping on the peak of life. But she loved him so much that she began to lose herself, and then, got a tragic end before rebirth... This life, the only things she wants are money and revenge. Who is that man? She doesn't care. However, why did he become so persistent? Chasing after her all the time! (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Your Distance
works.synopsis: My boyfriend that was 287km away is now 3km away? Professor Bo Chang Yi, used to be good at understanding others, but is now no longer humane. The happiness in Ting Shuang’s heart vanished in an instant, leaving only fear, if you think about it, it seems that there will be disaster in the near future. (Source: Bilibili Comics) Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

works.title: Reincarnated Marquis
works.synopsis: All others want to live forever while he wants to die; all others have to die while he couldn't die but he couldn't live, either. No matter how many time he dies, he'll be reincarnated and start a new life as a different person, but no matter how many times he revives, he won't live longer than one year and he dies again. All this because of the "Cops of death" in the underworld miscalculated his lifespan which contributes to him being tortured! "When could i die!" he howled and they kicked him to reincarnate again but this time, things are more interesting... (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Choose Wood and Dwell
works.synopsis: Eight years ago, the innocent, rich heir Jiang Yumian pursued his tutor Qin Heng; eight years later, the roles are reversed. The noveau rich Qin Heng reunites with his first love Yumian by chance. This time, he decides he will hold tight to him and not let go. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: There Goes the World
works.synopsis: During the year 2028, humans are practically wiped out by a plague of mutated viruses. Horrible monsters are wandering on the streets, and now Earth has turned into Hell . The lucky very few survivors hid underground, living in a subway network that is easy to guard, but the protagonist and his team had no choice but to leave the safe dungeon to escape this wasteland… (Source: Original Publisher, translated)

works.title: I Grind Dungeons Around the World
works.synopsis: Su Mu wakes up to find himself in a parallel world where everyone reaches the age of 18 is mandated to participate in a game called Space which consists of a series of deadly survival games. How will Su Mu, a former private detective, survive the very first death-dealing hide & seek game? (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: The Encounter with Fox
works.synopsis: The little fox went downhill to avoid the calamity. She encounters the rich and handsome professor Tian You. Getting along with each other day by day, the naughty and cute little fox, Xiaojiu, gradually fell in love with Tian You. But the calamity made Xiaojiu show herself in her true form. And the real identity of Tian You was unknown to everyone. Meanwhile, the brother of Xiaojiu, who was a superstar, found her and took her away... Can Xiaojiu and Tian You reunite? (Source: WebComics)

works.title: My Vampire System
works.synopsis: The human Race is at war with the Vicious Dalki and when they needed help more than ever, THEY started to come forward. Humans who had hidden in the shadows for hundreds of years, people with abilities. Some chose to share their knowledge to the rest of the world in hopes of winning the war, while others kept their abilities to themselves. Quinn had lost everything to the war, his home, his family and the only thing he had inherited was a crummy old book that he couldn’t even open. But when the book had finally opened, Quinn was granted a system and his whole life was turned around. He completed quest after quest and became more powerful, until one day the system gave him a quest he wasn’t sure he could complete. "It is time to feed!" "You must drink huma n blood within 24 hours" "Your HP will continue to decrease until the task has been completed" (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Zhuang Po Huangdi Nüer Shen
works.synopsis: After transmigrating to another world as a wealthy young master, Su Changqing only wanted to live a low-profile life as a rich second-generation heir and enjoy his days in comfort. However, his plans are suddenly disrupted when his family faces an unexpected crisis, and he accidentally discovers the Emperor's secret - that she is actually a woman. While he initially feared the female Emperor would stop at nothing to silence him, to his surprise, she instead becomes interested in his mysterious ability to transform his appearance. She wants him to become her male body double. What Su Changqing never expected was that being the female Emperor's male substitute would mean he has to visit the imperial harem on his very first day. His peaceful life completely falls apart from that moment on... (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Mermaid's Egg
works.synopsis: A rich dandy ended up alone on a deserted island and brought a merman back to life accidentally. The merman is no ordinary but the High Priest of the Deserted Isle Tribe! The arrogant boy, somehow, was trapped on the island and forced to hatch eggs... “I have my self-esteem!” “Ancient tribes are horrible... I have no choice but to trust Mr. Merman with my life...” (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Embrace My Shadow
works.synopsis: A transaction binds her and the noblest yet most awful man together. In the daytime, she’s one of the ordinary girls, but at night she can’t escape his control... He holds her chin, smiling evilly: "The entire Dongling is mine, do you think you can run away?" (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Spirit Catcher
works.synopsis: Once upon a time, an ungifted Taoist by the name of Qin Que stole the Book of Earth, fled the Wudang Mountain, and used human sacrifices to enhance his power. Grandmaster Xie Luo descends the mountain to pursue this man, but the trail goes cold for many years. Then one day, he finds a clue to finding the traitor while helping investigate an unsolved occult case. (Source: Tappytoon)

works.title: A Harem for My Empress
works.synopsis: My beloved, my empress... though it pained me to leave you so soon, I did my best to secure a comfortable future for you and our son. I left for the underworld prepared to wait for you there, so you can imagine my surprise when I return to find you… WITH YOUR OWN PRIVATE HAREM! Just who the hell are all these men?! And why are you touching their—HEY! That’s it! “Until death do us part” be damned! Brace yourself, my beloved. I’ll see to it that you rue the day you decided to revel in my death! (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Princess, Please Stay Away From Me!
works.ar: 公主殿下请离我远一点啊
works.synopsis: Women? It’s fine to play with them for a bit, but as for those sacred vows professing eternal love? Heh, I’m sorry. I won’t believe a single word! Especially if they’re coming from the mouth of a beautiful girl… That’s what I used to think. However, after I transmigrated one day and was bedded by a certain loli princess, I… seem to have changed. (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Long Yin Zhe
works.synopsis: Xia Yan, a run-of-the-mill university student. His life had become exciting ever since he received the inheritance of a lich from another world. Unrivalled in the city along with his horde of treasured skeletons, he’s acclaimed as both a death god and a superhero. A campus queen, a pop diva, and a dom chairwoman… all of them live cosily under the illumination of Xia Yan’s soul fire. Vampires? Werewolves? Angels? Demons? Crush ‘em all! A bone dragon battles a helicarrier, an undead scourge creates a biohazard. All who mess with the lich get their comeuppance.

works.title: Yong Sheng
works.synopsis: The humble house-slave Fang Han traveled the world to build up his own strength, forging his ordinary flesh into an immortal body. Now he will step into the immortal realm and claim his rightful place on top of the throne! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Stay With The CEO
works.synopsis: Yan Jing has always believed that there is nothing she can't do in this world until she meets her imperious boss... (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Young Sorcerer Master
works.synopsis: As the strongest sorcerer of nine states of China, he was expelled by his family for practicing the ultimate martial manual, Which is regarded as a unforgivable action that against the rule of ancestor. But his mother managed to send him to a new land, where he begins a new journey of cultivation… (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Falling to Where I Belong
works.synopsis: Cheng Fei Chi: Gentle, introverted, bookish. Ye Ming: Tsundere, proud, and hotheaded. A young love never dies- it always falls where it belongs! (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Morbid Attachment
works.synopsis: "An Alpha being in love with another Alpha is taboo!", "Perverts", "You sick people!"...That's what people would say if they knew about the relationship between Ji Wang, a self-restrained Alpha actor, and Qi Boyan, a flamboyant actor and singer, who claims to be an Omega but secretly loves to dominate other Alphas. A mishap tore their relationship apart six years ago. But when fate puts them together again as co-stars in a popular movie, they are forced to face the burning temptation while resolving their past misunderstandings... (Source: INKR, edited)

works.title: Charm of Soul Pet
works.synopsis: Cloud birds that soar through the blue sky; Terrorblood wolves that roam the wastelands ruthlessly. Dream beasts that dart through the moonlight forests; Ghost kings that dwell on foggy cliffs. Ocean spirit beasts that haunt the depths of the boundless oceans; thousand-eyed treants that stand unyielding on precipitous peaks. Sword Beetles, Sunset Eagles, Ancient Wood Demons, Chaotic Thunder Sprites, Cursed Demon Fox: Ice… Plants, Beasts, Elementals, Undead, this is the eccentric, variegated, beautiful, and stunning world of soul pets! Our protagonist, a soul pet trainer, had at first a young, mutated soul pet – a Moonlight Fox. In unending fights, it mutated into the stronger Evil Flamed Six-tailed Demon fox and the even higher leveled Queen Flamed Nine-tailed Firefox! Under the companionship of this soul pet, he walked on the path to become a king, catching precious and rare soul pets, and never ceasing his endeavor to becoming the very best!

works.title: Poisonous Phoenix
works.synopsis: In her last life she devoted everything to her beloved, the third prince. However her devotion was met with the sharp dagger of betrayal, as the man whom she loved carved her heart out. Years later, she is reincarnated as the bride to be of her enemy’s brother, the fifth prince, a silly prince whom the royal family regards as worthless. In him she sees her past pitiful self and promises to protect this foolish yet kind prince. But is this foolish prince really all that he seems? Can she really protect him and seek revenge for her past life? Certainly the royal family has nothing to fear of this dimwitted prince and his beloved wife who is seeking revenge… Right?

works.title: Bai Sui Kai Xitong, Xiaozi Xiansun Gui Man Shan!
works.ar: 百岁开系统，孝子贤孙跪满山！
works.synopsis: Xiao Chen is a transmigrator who has lived a long, peaceful life and is now lying nearing death at the age of 100, when his System finally activated. Now he can earn rewards if his descendants have children. Not only will he get stronger, his lifespan will be extended, too! So go forth and procreate! All my children, young and old, men and women, get out there and breed! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: When Beauty Meets Beasts
works.synopsis: Lin Huanhuan, a regular 20-year-old girl who just joined the workforce, suddenly transmigrated while taking a bath! What’s more, it’s a world filled with handsome men who wear loincloths and can transform into beasts! Romance with another race is bound to be difficult, but luckily, there’s a transmigration system which teaches her how to survive in this strange new world. Study hard to achieve your sweet romance, Huanhuan! (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: My Girlfriend Is Long Aotian
works.synopsis: In legends, the most powerful person in the world is called Long Aotian... I always thought it was the name of a man, but she was actually the name of a beautiful woman?! She can make people think she's amazing without knowing why with just a cold smile, and bring people to their knees with a single stomp! She can flatten mountains with a flick of her hand! She can tear the skies open with a single finger! She is invincible and unparalleled in the world! However most importantly... She is my girlfriend and listens to everything I say! (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Deathwalker Chronicles: From Murloc to Glory
works.ar: 与死亡同行：从鱼人地下城开始
works.synopsis: After unlocking the hidden class “Deathwalker,” becoming a legendary adventurer should be straightforward… right? (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: There's Something Wrong With this Account
works.synopsis: I was transferred to another world after I created an account with a character of full Charisma?! Something must have gone wrong with that account! As an experienced player, I will make my name in the new world. That account is new, but it surely will bring surprises! (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Wudi Jian Yu
works.synopsis: Invincible Sword Domain, Yang Ye was a disciple of the Sword Sect and was born with great fortune and bad luck. He joined the Sword Sect and studied for many years, but his energy was absorbed by the Hong Meng Pagoda. (Source: AC.QQ, translated)

works.title: Nü Shi Zunmen Dou Xiang Zhanyou Wo
works.synopsis: Xiao Nan died tragically and then isekai-ed to the 21st Continent. Although reborn as useless trash, he awakened the reverse system, and his strength would increase as long as he was hurt. What he didn’t know was that he had a hidden identity-as the chosen son of heaven who was prophesized to revitalize the Sword sect. The elders of all factions in the sect therefore hid their identities and approached Xiao Nan to try to recruit him into their own ranks. Since then, Xiao Nan began to enjoy being nurtured by beautiful female masters, whilst discovering features of the system to become stronger + start a harem. (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: Assassin Took Home
works.synopsis: Ding Yi, an ordinary delivery guy, saved a beautiful, wounded woman assassin from coma on his way home. How can Ding Yi survive around this elusive and indifferent killer? As the wheel of destiny turns, comes an adventurous and exciting world of assassination. (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Jian Wu
works.synopsis: He was a part of the top 10 players in the beta test for "Sword Dance Online", but when he was put into a vegetative state after the car accident, he became a monster in the game. After endless amounts of time spent getting stronger, he soon struck terror to the noobs of the server and encountered affectionate situations with countless women.

works.title: Arranged Marriage With My Beloved Wife
works.ar: 枕上娇妻交易婚约别当真
works.synopsis: She was forced to marry a crippled president for the sake of her family. Reluctant to accept the marriage at first, she kept a distance with her nominal husband. But his love and respect slowly unsealed her heart... (Source: Mangatoon)

works.title: Wuxian Bianyi
works.synopsis: Zhao Yifan was transported to an alternative reality after a Zombie Apocalypse occurred. There, the surviving humans gathered together and built the "Academy" as a refuge against the zombies. However, despite the top-notch security of the Academy, it was no safer than the zombie-infested outside world. While at the Academy, Zhao Yifan turned into a mutant with the ability to absorb the powers of other zombies after he was bitten by a variant zombie. In order to protect the people he cares about, Zhao Yifan must use the powers at his disposal to find a way to survive!

works.title: Dr. Don
works.synopsis: In the old days, the streets in the downtown area are now dead silent. Hoarse and frantic weird whispers entangled in the sky, and the indescribable ancient giant shadow of a cosmic being floating in the sea. Unknown disease outbreaks, terrible disasters raging, panic among humans. It's the end of times where humans sought in vain refuge day and night. The rain is blood-drenched, and the lightning illuminated the sky gathering the crows to feast on corpses, never again, never again, they replied. "We can see that this weird creature has twelve pairs of ribs just like humans, but it also has a transverse bone piece that humans don't have..." In medical school, He continued to wield to scalpel to save the people. These medical students showed the thoracic structure of the weird creature on the experimental platform. The mysterious and treacherous age has come, the truth has collapsed, the order has collapsed, and mankind can only move forward unyielding through intellectual power while insanity creeps in… closer ever so slightly. "What will you do?" Let the madness guide you. (Source: AC.QQ, translated)

works.title: It's Not Easy to Be a Man After Travelling to the Future
works.ar: 穿越未来之男人不好当
works.synopsis: After dying from a strange terminal illness, Ling Lan was reborn into a world 10,000 years into the future. Although she dearly wished she could just live a peaceful and uneventful life in her new healthy body, fate had other plans… Forced to disguise herself as a boy just so she could inherit her deceased father’s premium military benefits, Ling Lan’s journey to adulthood was full of challenges. After much difficulty, she finally turned sixteen when she could drop the charade. But before she could grasp her newfound freedom to get married and start her own family, a twist of fate results in her being thrown into the Federation’s top military boys’ school. With these twists of fate, Ling Lan had little choice but to walk further and further down a path of no return, one of cold and aloof dominance…

works.title: Seeing Xinghuo Again
works.synopsis: Through an old camera in the club's storage room, Gu An saw something that should not exist. She was a shooting star from three years ago named "Xinghuo." Why do you stay in the night sky? Why am I the only one who can see you? Gu An, who usually follows the crowd, wants to investigate and take the initiative for the first time in her life. As an observer and "the most important friend," Gu An and Xinghuo set on a journey to find the former club members and fulfill their dreams from three years ago. "It's... been exposed." "But, I'm really happy. Thank you, Gu An." (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Shuma Baolong D-CYBER: Chao Jinhua Long Hun Zhan Ji
works.ar: 數碼暴龍D-CYBER 超進化龍魂戰記
works.synopsis: Ten thousand years ago, a great and powerful Digimon was defeated and sealed away by the Holy Knights as the "Digi Core". Years later, a virus infected the digital world, leaving only those that possessed the D-Antibody (X-Antibody) remaining. The only members of the Holy Knights remaining are Omega of Power (Omnimon X), Duke of Courage (MedievalGallantmon/Gallantmon X), and Magna of Miracles (Magnamon). At the start of the series, the "God of Death" MetalPhantomon draws Hikaru, Kiyoshi, Masuken, and Teru into the digital world. Originally, Hikaru is left alone with his Digimon (which starts out as a Dorimon), and has to battle his friends Teru and Masuken, who are under MetalPhantomon's control. (Source: Wiki)

works.title: Pan Long 2
works.synopsis: This sequel occurs 10 years after the original Panlong. Note: Includes one extra chapter.

works.title: My Apprentice: Game Over Again!
works.synopsis: Revered as the most powerful person in cultivation, Grand Master Yu Yan eventually took on an apprentice after waiting for over 16,000 years. He offered careful instruction and protection to her, but she died in the end. Then, Yu Yan took another one as his apprentice, with great instruction and protection, but she died as well! After that, he took on one another, and finally ... she died! Why it is Yu Yan who is always picking up the same reborned apprentice! (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Offering My Neck To You
works.synopsis: Fang Luoan, a half-werewolf, was five years old when his father was killed. He was then adopted by vampire Fang Yanchen. Today, twelve years later, as Fang Luoan is about to reach adulthood, his werewolf attributes are beginning to emerge. His uncontrollable emotions and the abnormal power he has have caused a ton of terrible troubles. But what he never expected is that Fang Yanchen, whom he has been living with, is the foe that killed his father… (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Evenly Matched Love
works.synopsis: “If the Aslan family knew other genes had “invaded” their bloodline, they might hurt your twins!” Magic, mecha, mana, demon foxes, and space travel. There’s a lot that’s unique about Mu Yunshen’s world. Most interestingly... for a select few men, pregnancy is also a possibility. Of course, Mu Yunshen doesn’t know about this last little detail—yet. After he saves the life of young master Aslan and spends the night with him, Mu Yunshen ends up with the shock of his life: twins. (Source: Comikey)

works.title: Kai Ju Huo De Shenmai De Wo Wudi Le
works.ar: 开局获得神脉的我无敌了
works.synopsis: I, Sheng Xiang, was born into a martial family, but I lacked the talent for cultivation, which made me unwanted and unloved by my clan. But things can change. One day, I fell into a cave in the wilderness, and there I found two incredible beauties. When I realized that they're unable to move, lust began to overwhelm my rational thoughts… (Source: iQiyi, translated)

works.title: Help! Because Of A BUG, I'm Getting Pestered By The Game's Babes!
works.ar: 救命！因为出了BUG，我被游戏美少女缠上了
works.synopsis: Game characters come to life because of a bug?! Blossom, the ancient-style girl with an ancient mindset; Cthylla, the mature girl who comes from a mysterious world; Gumi, an idol of the Meow Country, Gumi; II, the mischievous, petite magical girl, and No.7, the AI-powered agent who loves money... A group of beautiful girls appears and pesters the female game producer. Is this the beginning of a wonderful harem life? No, this is the beginning of a chaotic cohabitation life. (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: A Mage, but Also a Scientist
works.synopsis: This is a world where magic and science both exist. In this world, some people want powerful magic; some people pursue eternal truth. Blair, the protagonist, is a math teacher from a different world. Using both magic and science, he will soon achieve success in a way that no one has thought of before! A great scholar? The supreme mage? A lady-killer? I guess a few more titles won't hurt. (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: The Journey
works.synopsis: The story about a special service agency that deals with people’s previous lives. Whoever sows sparingly will reap sparingly and whoever sows generously will reap generously. No one knows. In this line of trade of ours, we offer you a chance to return back to your past life. discover the origin of your troubles, seek redemption, and reshape the course of your current life. For such a service, we do not ask for money. Instead we desire. a single drop of your tear. (Source: Mangatoon)

works.title: The Demon of Vengeance
works.synopsis: In a prosperous city, there are many races- which are beyond the understanding of humans- hidden in society. The strength and the prosperity of these races not only depends on their own growth, but also on human belief and worship of them. However, as more people in modern society believe less in them, the more their numbers and strength diminish. Although there are still some powerful and ancient beings, they can only try their best to hide in corners of the world or pretend to be human. On the other hand, there are other races with dark purposes who call themselves the "Devil Hunter Association". In order not to be discovered by the demon hunters and not targeted by humans, various races worked hard to integrate into human society.

works.title: Justice Mask
works.synopsis: A villainous space-time traveler randomly took over the body of a noble who was a role model of justice and obtained a system disguised as a villain's training manual! How was he supposed to choose between good and evil? To carry out justice or to play evil? Or simply both! (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: I'm Being Shipped With the King of Film!
works.synopsis: Whaaa?! The demon spirit management just arranged a husband for me again?! This time, the guy's a movie god! OMG~ I'm only a recently matured small fox. Arranging such an old demon to me, what am I to do~

works.title: World of Ruins
works.synopsis: In the post-civilization era, Earth witnessed frequent anomalies. Strange fruits appeared in famous mountains and rivers, causing living beings to undergo mutations upon consuming them. Chu Feng, a college student, accidentally ventured into the Bronze Kunlun Mountain during a journey after a breakup. At the moment of Earth's recovery, he unexpectedly awakened the bloodline of the Supreme King, embarking on a path of cultivation to dominate the world! (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: I'm Just a Side Character in a Dating Simulation
works.ar: 原来我是恋爱游戏里的工具人
works.synopsis: On that day, a girl wearing strawberry underwear fell from the sky. “This place is actually set in a GAL Game world!” And not only was I, who was raised in a prosperous family and was outstanding in everything not the main character, but I was also instead this world’s villainous and antagonistic Eldest Young Master?! I had decided. I shall forge an alliance with the strawberry girl, and together we shall wage war upon the main character for the one true love! I don’t care for his main character’s aura or his Yasashii Strategy. I shall open up a grand path to becoming the main character! I refuse to be a side character in a dating sim!" (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Rhodes Island's Records of Originium - Blacksteel
works.synopsis: Arknights official comic featuring daily life of Blacksteel members, Vanilla, Jessica, Liskarm and Franka, who joined Rhodes Island for the first time. It also elaborates the relationship between Franka and Liskarm since the former's Infection after the Ironforge Originium leakage incident in Columbia.

works.title: I Know Your Secret
works.synopsis: After she was nearly killed and then rescued, Ruan Ruan lost all her memories. Her savior, Ding Xiao, treated her with all the tenderness in the world; she completely let her guard down in the face of his perfect image. After figuring out the identity of her attacker, Ruan Ruan naively thought they were heading toward a happy ending. However, after discovering Ding Xiao's secret, her world turned upside down! With danger looming on all sides, will she continue to be the prey, or will she become the hunter? (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Hate You, Love You
works.synopsis: Lance has been in love with his best friend Danny, since they were kids. However, something from his childhood looms over Danny's heart, preventing him from finding love with boys. They say that you can't wake a person who's pretending to sleep, but with the help of his best girl friend, will Lance be able to open Danny's eyes and live happily ever after? (Source: Tapas) Note: Chapter count includes 21 extras.

works.title: Travel to AD 3000
works.synopsis: This story is about a girl from the year 2011 that time-traveled to the year 3011. In year 3011, machines with consciences have taken over some of the humans and some humans with special powers have appeared. All of them want world domination but the humans want their freedom. She is caught between this conflict and struggles to be with the one she loves. (Source: INKR, edited)

works.title: My Self-Discipline Makes Me Invincible
works.synopsis: This is a world where monsters lurk and thousands of Sects thrive. If you’re not careful, your life will be at risk. However, all of this has nothing to do with Li Dan, because as long as he discipline himself, he can receive corresponding rewards and become perfectly invincible! “Ding: Congratulations to the host for persisting in daily exercise. Here’s a top level cultivation tutorial.” “Ding: new self-discipline task released-- persist in professing your love to the most beautiful woman in the Sect for a month, and you’ll have a mysterious talent.” (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: The Strongest Demon Becomes the Protagonist's Strategist
works.ar: 最强魔尊的退休生活从攻略主角开始
works.synopsis: Game designer Zhou Yuzai suddenly died while working overtime and transmigrated into the cultivation game he was working on. He became the main antagonist Wei Buwang, who had killed the female lead Jiang Yunbo's entire family. Zhou Yuzai thought he would have it easy in his own game, but Jiang Yunbo's tendency to die in game also reset him back to the start, too. It turned out that even though he was a powerful demon lord, he was still just an NPC compared to the actual main character Jiang Yunbo. So he decided to help Jiang Yunbo get stronger instead, and pick up his own harem along the way! (Source: Bilibili, translated) Notes: Includes one bonus chapter.

works.title: Tian Sheng Du Nai, Wo Zuzhou Le Quan Shijie!
works.ar: 天生毒奶，我诅咒了全世界！
works.synopsis: A parallel game world merges with the modern world, and now ferocious monsters and alien races roam the land. In the wilds, there are many dungeons and hidden realms to explore. Humans have awakened news skills and professions, and they must defeat monsters to level up. On the day of the awakening, Lin Luo found himself with the profession of priest, which was the most popular class, but had no damage ability of its own. Just when he was wondering what to do, he discovered that his skills had mutated! His healing abilities now take away health instead? His blessings have turned into curses? But I am supposed to be a priest healer! (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: A Free Ride Everyday
works.synopsis: When she left work, Cheng Huan unexpectedly ran into Liao Jia, her senior from high school who worked at the company. Hitching rides from Liao Jia was the perfect opportunity for them to see each other regularly. And for some reason, Cheng Huan was always able to catch a ride from her senior. Before they knew it, they began to realize their feelings for each other — and each ride became a chance for them to build their relationship. (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: No Way, My Best Actress Wife
works.synopsis: I thought this was just about me coming back to the stage. Who’d expect layers after layers of mysteries, lies, and conspiracies? Love that was once lost, memories that flood back, turns out we’ve loved each other time after time. (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: The Ultimate Immortal
works.synopsis: Ling Fei Will fight though two worlds will he be able to unravel to secret of both? After an accident he woke up in a mystical cultivation realm. But when earth called him back he had the chance to relive his life on earth. What will he do with this second chance?

works.title: Zhengyi De Wo Bei Xitong Bi Cheng Da Fanpai
works.ar: 正义的我被系统逼成大反派
works.synopsis: Lin Bei, who transmigrated to become the second-ranked disciple of the Qingyun Sect, wanted to be a good guy. But he was paired with a System that specialized in cultivating super villains. Now Lin Bei has to go against his original intentions by becoming a Big Bad, and he must fight off all the wannabe heroes of the Nine Continents in order to survive! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Wo Kao Qian Dao Ni Tian Gai Ming
works.synopsis: After our male protagonist transmigrated, he was somehow taken in by the all-women Yunü Sect, and given a job as the doorman. When he jumped to the other world, he was blessed with the Super Sign-In System and given the unprecedented ability of Carnal Cultivation. He had to stimulate women, and their excitement will become his cultivation. The Yunü Sect was threatened by enemies on all sides. To protect his (women) saviors, he will take advantage of the Super Sign-In System to defeat enemies, slay demons, fight off monsters, conquer the wilds, and make himself into a god. (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Wo Zai Yijie Dang Daheng
works.synopsis: In the modern world, Xu Fei is an ordinary three-no college student: no looks, no money, and no future. But in the other-world, he is a martial artist, a cultivator, and a magician. The other-world martial arts skills make him unbeatable in the modern world, but it's not like an overwhelming super-power. The other-world resembles ancient times, where medicine, economics, and political systems are still primitive. Being able to travel between the two worlds, Xu Fei will use his unique skills to pick up women and become a tycoon in each world!

works.title: Summer Never Ends
works.synopsis: On the first day of high school, Wei made up her mind to confess to her childhood sweetheart who she had a crush on. Due to being overly nervous, she actually confessed to the wrong person… What kind of campus life would await her in the future?

works.title: I'm Not An Evil Antagonist Actress
works.synopsis: A b*tch-looking supporting actress made a pact with a handsome star actor with a creepy addiction for her career. Let’s see how this strong girl will fight and reach her career success!

works.title: All starts with Ubume
works.synopsis: Li Yan, diagnosed with a fatal disease, accidentally found his way into the strange world of Purgatory. Step by step, relying on his fighting skills, he became a powerful figure. And as he traveled through the realms of Purgatory, he was able to uncover the truth behind this world. (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: The Concubine Is A Man
works.synopsis: Xie Yanhuan, disguised as Chen's Ninth Princess, was forced to marry Emperor Yan Gui as a surrogate. On the night of the wedding, Xie Yanhuan's true identity is revealed, all hope appears to be lost. Isn't Xie male? Yan is aware of this, but why doesn't Yan seem angry? (Source: INKR) Notes: - Includes four extra chapters - Originally published under the title Zhuan Chong Guifei Shi Nanren (专宠贵妃是男人)

works.title: Taming The Possessive Girl
works.synopsis: "100 Yuan, your tips. Take care." Take advantage of the Lord of this city, you dare want to take it as nothing happened? No way! (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Wo Zhen Bu Shi Mowang
works.synopsis: "Awaken from the killing and become the strongest demon king!" In order to survive, young Fang Cheng was forced to sign a contract with a Slayer Demon. For each demon he hunts down, he can unlock a new ability. Facing this dark age of demonic invasion, Fang Cheng vows to fight back and become the strongest! (Source. Tencent, translated)

works.title: Pandora's Heart
works.synopsis: In this world, demons threaten to emerge from corrupted hearts. To protect everyone, each person’s chest is installed with a Heartlock with varying degrees of security. But young Louis can afford only the simplest of Heartlock since he has no money or privilege. After his innermost desires are exposed by his closest friend, he is framed and sent away. Surrounded by the demons of other tormented inmates, can the innocent Louis and his delicate heart survive this new hell? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Shi Wen Lun Xian
works.synopsis: In a world populated by beastmen, the down-and-out actress, Shen Youqing, happens to be a chinchilla-girl. During an audition, she was nearly sexually assaulted by the assistant director. But she's saved in the nick of time by someone she hadn’t seen in years: Shi Ruolin, who was her first love, arranged marriage partner, fiancée, and mortal enemy. Shen Youqing was looking for a chance to escape, not even bothering to thank her savior, but Shi Ruolin makes her an unexpected offer. Facing dire straits, Shen Youqing gives in to temptation and agrees to endure the humiliation of becoming the pet of the cold-blooded snake, in exchange for a large sum of money. As they spend more time together, they manage to resolve their long-standing misunderstandings, and their mutual feelings grow until they finally agree to spend the rest of their lives together. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: Miss Divine Doctor: Conquer The Demon King
works.ar: 我在异界养男神：神医九小姐
works.synopsis: Jun Jiu, the divine doctor, was killed by her competitor and time travelled to another world. She breaks into a sealed altar, and a mysterious man snatches her chin and forces her... Who's this arrogant demon?! (Source: Mangatoon)

works.title: Secret of Immortality
works.synopsis: A lowly servant, who always gets bullied and insulted by others, suddenly received a magical training technique. Ever since then, he became a cultivating genius, counterattacked to those who used to offend him, and started a prideful life! (Source: WebComics)

works.title: Futangdaohuo Yuwen Jun
works.synopsis: Yuwen Jun (Cheng) came to Japan to get married because of childhood arrangement. Instead he got himself into a thrilling journey where kendo masters, detective sisters, young misses of rich families entangled with him. Yuwen Jun was stunned while facing so many unexpected incidents: "I just came to get married..."

works.title: Ao Jiao Wangye Tai Nan Zhui
works.synopsis: This is a story about a murdered lady, who then time travels and is reborn as the second daughter in a wealthy household. She was often bullied in her own household. After time travelling, she acts all frail and weak in the situations she encounter, while intelligently overcoming crisis after crisis. Even without a royal background, she is slowly but surely climbing to the top!

works.title: Breathless
works.synopsis: Uh-oh, River is in love with his oblivious best friend Sea... Will he confess to him during their grad trip? Perhaps... But little does River know that true danger lurks below still waters, waiting for him. Freediving deep underwater, he spots a mysterious stranger chained to a ship at the bottom of the ocean. As local lore goes, vampires once roamed the lands until a bloody event changed everything. Is River hallucinating? And just what is real? Take a deep breath... and dive in. (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Express Delivery? Boyfriend Delivery!
works.synopsis: Zou Xiao An is a delivery guy who works 9-to-5 every day. Though it’s kind of tiring running hither and thither, he can somehow make a quite great living. However, a company called Kaifeng International is within his delivery scope today, which is exactly the last place he would like to visit. Why? Because sadly enough, the President of Kaifeng International has taken a fancy to him. (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Zui Qiang Zhanshen Naiba
works.synopsis: The “Battle of the Gods” was a thing of the past, and the name “Lin Zhizun” was buried and forgotten. His daughter bullied, his wife insulted, Lin Feng finally woke up from his slumber: I guarded the 10 million square kilometers of Shenhua territory, but I can’t guard my own home!? The supreme being will return to the top! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Rise of the Supreme Villain
works.synopsis: Vicent Wayland, a super-rich and incredibly handsome man, meets a tragic end at the hands of the Dragon King’s son-in-law. But fate has other plans—he unexpectedly triggers the Supreme Villain System and gets a second chance at life. Determined to become the ultimate villain, Yin Wudao vows to bring hell to all who stand in his way. From dragon heirs and divine doctors to war gods, Asuras, ancient martial arts masters, and reborn immortals—no one is safe from his wrath. Witness the rise of a legendary villain in “Rise of the Supreme Villain”! (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Slightly Sour Secret
works.synopsis: Have you ever been confused about love? In the end what is "true love" like? Our female lead now is standing at a fork in the road. On one side, her close childhood friend is waiting for her reply. On the other side, there stands her college friend whom she cannot just let go. Where does this love triangle lead to? (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: Rebirth: Giving You My Exclusive Affection
works.ar: 重生相逢：给你我的独家宠溺
works.synopsis: Yun Xiangxiang was reborn as her seventeen-year-old self. She swore that she would never let herself be bullied in this life. She slapped her cheating fiancé and made a high-profile announcement that she was looking for a partner. However, she was forced to accept a crippled man. Yun Xiangxiang was ridiculed and mocked but that man treated her like the apple of his eye. When people insulted or bullied her, he would make them pay a hundred times over. One day, Yun Xiangxiang exclaimed in surprise, "You can walk!?". The man looked at her innocently and said, "I never said that I can’t." (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: The Magic Chef of Fire and Ice: Season 2
works.synopsis: Season 2 of The Magic Chef of Fire and Ice.

works.title: The Revered One Has a History: Me and My Suddenly Appearing Children
works.synopsis: After a long and desperate struggle, Master Ling Yunfeng and his group of stalwart followers have finally restored peace to the world. Just as he was about enjoy his hard-earned peace and quiet, he suddenly realized that during the long war, he had a lot of casual affairs, some of which ended up with kids! Now it's time for payback! The Supreme Master, with no experience in romantic relationships or child raising, is now facing an entirely new battlefield! Sometimes, love and family comes at you fast! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Divine Card Creator
works.synopsis: Other people transmigrate with a full set of superpowers. Lu Ming found himself reincarnated into a new world with a buttload of debt while being blackmailed with embarrassing cross-dressing photos. Wasn't being an overworked-to-death programmer bad enough already? But wait, there are all sorts of fantastical professions available here, and his profession is that of a "Cardmaker." Lu Ming realized that making these cards is just like writing a program, so with his skill, he can create unlimited possibilities in this world?! (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: Love Diagnosis
works.synopsis: Will Jiu~ tell me your thoughts? An eccentric psychiatrist to the stars, Will Jiu finds himself saddled with a student intern he doesn't want. Lianne is sassy, rebellious, and used to wrapping people around her finger, but now she's met her match. Forced to come together, these two butt heads as they help clients face their mental health issues. But even as they guide others to breakthroughs and healing, can Will and Lianne ever see eye to eye and diagnose the problems in their own relationship? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Ke Jin Feng Shen
works.synopsis: In this era of martial arts, those who don't awaken their martial arts are known as primitive humans. Xiao Wudao is an arrogant and disrespectful child. His father is a rich man while his adopted brother is a martial artist. One day, his brother turned on the family and killed everyone. Suddenly, Xiao Wudao found himself awoken one year before that faithful day. Now, he will protect his family and won't redo the mistakes in his past life.

works.title: Dafeng's Night Squad
works.synopsis: In this world, there are Confucianists, Taoists, Buddhists, demons, and priests. When Xu Qi'an, a police academy graduate, woke up from a coma, he found himself imprisoned, and he would be banished to the border in three days. At first, he only wanted to save himself and be a rich guy who could live leisurely in a society without human rights… Many years later, when Xu Qi'an looked back on his life, his enemies had died, and he had killed many people. Time flew, and heroes passed away. Everything they did, whether good or bad, successful or not, was eventually swept off by time. Yet the world remains unchanged, and the sun still rises and sets as usual. (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Bug Boy Boyfriend
works.synopsis: Like most high school girls, Xiao Fan deals with your typical daily dramas. Taming messy bed head, dodging the mean girls at school or, y'know, finding a naked bug-human hybrid in her living room?! A product of her mother's magic, Yamu is a bug boy and now Xiao Fan's housemate, aka the bane of her existence. He chews on wood, refuses to wear clothes and bugs Xiao Fan to death but why does she get butterflies whenever she's around him... (Source: Tapas) Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

works.title: Kaiju Zhuanzhi Caishen, Xunhua Yiwan Shen Chong!
works.ar: 开局转职财神，驯化亿万神宠!
works.synopsis: The apocalypse game swept across the globe and merged with the real world, causing the collapse of order. In his previous life, Ye Xiao devoted everything to elevating his fiancée, Liu Ruyan, to the pinnacle of power, only to have his heart literally ripped out by her on the day of their engagement and transplanted into her male best friend. Reborn into a new life, Ye Xiao resolves to ascend the throne alone. Before the game closes its recharge portal, he spends billions of his fortune to switch to a god-level profession. (Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

works.title: The Unrivalled Medical Sage
works.synopsis: Being a gifted doctor, and the best warrior, he married a strong-willed wife. What can he do about her?

works.title: The Hidden Descendants
works.synopsis: Since ancient times, all around the world, there have been myths related to snakes… If they are but an invention of human imagination, how can they be central to all religions? A story parting from an ancient snake-like temple… could actually be true? A girl with a mystical bloodline is about to be awakened and the search of mysterious totem will bring an inevitable change to all… “I will break free from this curse and change my destiny.” (Source: MangaToon) Note: Includes prologue and two extras chapters.

works.title: Life Going Wild With Plugins
works.synopsis: He was the high creator of the world who had his memories stripped away in order to live as a mortal. To protect himself, he bought a cheap guard who was dumb, naive, and didn't know any martial arts. But why do the rumors make his little guard sound like a cruel and bloodthirsty monster? (Source: INKR) Note: Chapter count includes 17 extras.

works.title: Indestructible Primordial Spirit
works.synopsis: Is reincarnation a coincidence or a necessity? Lu Qi has been reborn into his world where martial arts reign. With his highest level of comprehension, he obtains the most valuable treasures, searches for the heavenly dao, taks in female slaves, wipes out devils! Let’s step into this world where the primordial spirit is indestructible and the Heavenly Dao is eternal! (Source: Mangatoon)

works.title: Into the Net
works.synopsis: Lu Yi Fan, a dedicated basketball player, has successfully graduated from his delinquent-filled middle school and entered high school believing that he has escaped from the terrors of delinquents. But who would have known that the basketball team in his new school was composed of juvenile delinquents?

works.title: I'm Really Not A Goddess
works.synopsis: In the future, billions of people are immersed in a virtual world game. The ordinary teenager who accidentally entered the virtual game world to save his sister not only became a beautiful girl, but also couldn't exit from the game?! How will he adjust to his new gender and the big events that follow... (Source: WebComics) Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

works.title: Princess’s Happily-ever-after Marriage
works.synopsis: An ace killer in modern time got a time travel and reborn into a princess, whose husband is a powerful genius in the country. Being obedient and submissive to her husband and friendly to his concubines? No way! if you dare to challenge, just have a try! (Source: Manga Toon)

works.title: Baolie Shaonü
works.synopsis: After witnessing a girl who is exposed to bullying, the guy takes a step to stand up for her. However after getting beaten, he attracts the attention of a strange talking rabbit and tells the guy about a contract with him where he can get the power to defend the girl. Here, he's given his transformation, but not with his own gender. What will this lead him to... The story of a guy who turned into a cruel girl with strange abilities.

works.title: Yin Shan Meng Tan
works.synopsis: In the seclusion of an ancient temple in a deeply hidden, wooded mountain range, two strangers - a young woman and a mysterious young man who hides his face behind a monkey mask - meet as they seek shelter from a storm. In order to make it more comfortable to hold out against the pouring rain in the temple, the woman asks the man to tell her a story ... (Source: Chinabooks, translated) Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

works.title: AWM: PUBG
works.synopsis: When a superstar and a newbie gamer team up, sparks will fly and a legendary gaming duo's story will be forged! The flames of old will never die, will the young will continue to carry the torch! This is a story of how a superstar gamer helps an amateur rise in ranks and how they spark a story of drama and emotion. Despite some friction between the two, they will eventually become the most well known names in the gaming industry! (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: The Legendary Villain Princess
works.synopsis: I dedicated eight years to help him rule his empire, only for him to send me to my death by burning! My last wish before death was to be reborn so I can change my fate, and not make the same stupid mistake again! However… I was reborn into the body of my sworn enemy?! My revenge plan is proceeding smoothly, but a prince suddenly appeared and proposed marriage? Does he not know I already have 4 prince consorts?

works.title: The Exhilarating Life of a Sword God
works.ar: 剑神的生活才不要那么无聊
works.synopsis: After ten years of cultivation, I’ve become a Sword God. Time to head down the mountains and make a name for myself… (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: The Newbie Mage's Secret Dragon Farm
works.synopsis: Ling Enping wanted to prove his father's innocence and bring his family back to prominence, but he had no magical abilities to do so, until one day when he accidentally triggered the Dragon Farming System. Suddenly, he became a talented magician, the most powerful mage in the empire took him on as an apprentice, the king made him a duke, and he even became engaged to the princess. But amidst all the accolades lurked many hidden dangers, and even the System that helped awaken his talent was hiding a conspiracy of its own... (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: Honey, Don't Run Away
works.synopsis: What kind of love is worth bearing in mind for a lifetime. She is the mother of a four-year-old, and he is the overwhelming President. She spares no effort in keeping the secret that she once had saved him, but he keeps pushing her step by step. "Be my girl, I can give you anything you want. But, you can't betray me or leave me." She sneered her reply, "President Ji, you have a fiancee, and being your secret lover is the least thing I want to do, because people criticize and curse the other woman." (Source: Webcomics App)

works.title: Prince's Private Baby
works.synopsis: A young girl wakes up in a hotel room and sees a man lying on top of her, but all she can remember is having a drink with her sister. Luckily she manages to escape from more terror, but still ends up pregnant. She passes out after giving birth, and when she wakes up her stepsister and stepmother can no longer be found in the hospital... Five years later, she moves to Ningguo as an exchange med student, and with her is her 5 year old son who walks into another kid with identical appearance.

works.title: You Look Like My Son's Mommy
works.synopsis: Four years ago, she was framed by her own cousin, and got kicked out of the Bai fam. She knew she has to fight her way back and take revenge on that vicious woman. Four years later, she received a call from that woman. She swear she will not fall into her traps again. And she managed to escape from her claws. Actually she did much better this time, until a man dragged her into his bed once more... (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Vampire X Hunter
works.synopsis: This is a 200-year romantic story filled with love and hate. After sleeping for 200 years, the Vampire woke up to find his rival hunter is living with him! Did his memories fail him? This is simply unbelievable! (Source: Webnovel)

works.title: Jiyin Da Shidai
works.synopsis: When aliens invaders attacked Earth, humanity fought back valiantly to earn a brief respite. To continue fighting the advanced alien civilization, humanity began injecting genetic modifications to awaken superpowers. As the people evolved, the great age of genes has begun! Gong Xutui was injected with the genetic serum to become one of the evolved, but he didn't know what power his genetic mod had, even as dangerous enemies were approaching... (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: A Lucky Coin
works.synopsis: High school dropout Hank Yan has a lot of hobbies. Studying, live streaming his day to day, and beating up bullies as a hero vigilante?! One day, Hank saves a young man named Junior. Shy and suffering from a dark past of abuse, Junior is a lot like Hank. Both barely have parents, if they are alive at all, both are interested in one another. Is it luck that they met or…fate? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Kaiju Dian Man Meili Zhi
works.synopsis: Tai Yuan transmigrated into his favorite game and gained the Charisma System, which allowed him raise his charisma by completing missions. Let's see how Tai Yuan will use this ability to charm and seduce his way to the top! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Vanguard of Fencing
works.synopsis: After attaining the title of fencing champion at the Olympics, Chris died in a car accident. At the funeral, Lin Yifei found out about the feelings Chris had never revealed before. As Lin Yifei realizes the regrets Chris had before he died, he unexpectedly returned back to his childhood?! Since he had the chance to relive his life, Lin Yifei chose to accompany Chris on his journey to attaining that prestigious throne once again! (Source: Bilibili Comics) Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

works.title: Those Years In Quest Of Honour Mine
works.synopsis:
Yu Ziyou and Zhong Wan pledged allegiance to different sovereigns.

Both of them were talented people who appreciated each other yet had clashed openly and covertly before.

After losing the fight for the throne, Zhong Wan brought his two young masters with him to the distant frontier. For the sake of survival, he relied on that bit of friendship that existed between him and Yu Ziyou when they were young. He borrowed some of his personal belongings while also dropping various hints which made everyone think that there was something intimate going on between them.

Given the Yu Clan's powerful authoritative presence in the imperial court, this layer of relationship allowed Zhong Wan to live a much better life than before indeed. In addition, the stories he cooked up began to seem more and more realistic.

As rumors of their lovely romance spread a thousand miles into the horizon, Yu Ziyou, who was located in the distant capital city, eventually caught wind of his deeply moving and epic love affair. Having been completely brainwashed for seven years, Yu Ziyou fell into a trance and believed the stories. It seemed like something special really did happen between them back in those years… (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Trouble With The President
works.synopsis: Season 1: After a one night stand, Tong Tianai sneaked out the door, but not before leaving behind a provocative message signed only with a lip print. But she didn't know that the man is Qin Jinyang, the CEO of the Qin Group! He swore to find this woman, and the next day, all the major media outlets published a 'Wanted' notice on their front page! As she looked at her phone, Tong Tianai can feel her face turn red. She had messed with the wrong CEO! (Source: QQ, translated) Season 2: When her uncle conspired to take over her father's Boya Corporation, Shen Sixuan was driven out of her home and had to watch her father die from despair. To take back Boya, she will do whatever it takes, including seducing Qin Yichen, the young CEO of the Qin Group. But will the cold and domineering Qin Yichen really help her with her quest? (Source: iQiyi, translated) Season 1 contains 157 chapters. Season 2 contains 249 chapters.

works.title: Shi Shen Zhi Lu
works.synopsis: When countless of my classmates were addicted to the super popular game “Battle of the Gods”, I was not tempted. This game is highly realistic, based off of powerful historical generals and mythical figures, where they battle against each other! Your potential determines your fate, the winner becomes the king while those who are defeated, eat dust. Analysis failed….. What’s with this situation? Is it a bug? My profile can’t be matched with a character? In that case, congratulations on triggering the game’s hidden story! I accidentally…... Opened it.....

works.title: At Your Service, Kitty
works.synopsis: A night walking brings an unexpected treasure — a black cat with a huge diamond! But is it a cat? Hogging her bathtub, robbing her food and asking her to warm its bed... She put up with it all for its diamond, but the petty cat actually absconded! After that, she was shocked to know that her new boss has a diamond on his collar, which is exactly the same as the one on the collar of the cat she met at that night... (Source: Webnovels)

works.title: Mr. Intrigue's Love Game
works.synopsis: Having failed several times in her relationships, she got a flash marriage because of an accident... She thought her husband was just a humble assistant, but he turned out to be the man who’s in charge of a huge enterprise... Behind those countless deceptions and lies, how many secrets is he still hiding? (Source: Copin Comics)

works.title: Commander Yi's Spoiled Wife
works.ar: 盛世甜宠：易少的小萌妻
works.synopsis: Her boyfriend is getting married, but the bride isn’t her! She then becomes labelled as a third wheel and within a day, she went viral. Thousands of people online are cursing at her. So she decided to accept the Yi family’s third master's mysterious proposal. Since she is now a well-known lady, many women are offended by her and plots to destroy her. Luckily for her, she has Mr Perfect husband who counters every move and tries to protect her.

works.title: The Promise
works.synopsis: An Nuo is known to have no superpowers, but in truth his power is to read minds. He wished to escape the research facility, but the top evolver, Jing Ye, hinders his plan. In a world where superpowers reign supreme, will An Nuo survive with the help of Jing Ye? (Source: INKR)

works.title: Star Dream Idol Project
works.synopsis: The shining lights, the magnificent stage! Friendships created through singing, making a future through dancing, the girls embark on their journey towards their dreams! One who has lost status due to a scandal is hiding a plot behind her back. A pair of bosom friends, separated by fate. A girl who tries to exonerate her mother sets off on her journey for a talent competition. When the stage turns into an empty battlefield, she uses her voice to chase after her dreams. (Source: Webcomics)

works.title: 20 Twenty
works.synopsis: The story of a singer with cold hands and a warm heart and a considerate artist.

works.title: The Brilliant Village Doctor
works.synopsis: The mysterious youth, Lin Hao, is hired by a clinic as a doctor. His exceptional medical skills coupled with his strong personality breaks the silence of the clinic. operating on his donkey friends, curing the village chief's cancer all kinds of strange and complicated diseases,this village doctor has become very popular. let's see how Lin Hao would describe this legendary life of his! (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Cong Yi Ba Jian Kaishi Shalu Jinhua
works.ar: 从一把剑开始杀戮进化
works.synopsis: Ye Fan was reborn as a strange sword with its own upgrade system. The sword is upgraded as the wielder kills with it, and it quickly became known as a powerful cursed weapon that people fought over. Whenever the sword is drawn, a bloody storm will follow. Meanwhile, Ye Fan is just trying to do whatever it takes to transform back into human form… (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Conglingkaishi de Moshi Shenghuo
works.synopsis: When doomsday arrives, and the world gets dragged into chaos, zombies and monsters start appearing. The Earth gets turned into a game, humans become the lowest in the food pyramid, the prey for all superior beings. After struggling in the doomsday for three years, Kong Zhe returned back to the day doomsday arrived. He discovers that he has his memories of the past, but as time passes by he realizes that he has more cards to play than expected ....How will he survive in doomsday? (Source: AC.QQ, translated)

works.title: Nüshen de Jin Shen Huwei
works.synopsis: Xiao Zheng was forced into signing a marriage and employment contract after a one night stand with the female executive of New Arcana Group. During this time, he encountered many interesting female workers which he named them based on their unique characters… Ice Goddess… Tyrannosaurus / Overlord Flower… Gentle Boss… Mischievous School Girl…

works.title: Yi Bu Xiao Xin, Ming Chui Qian Shi
works.synopsis: When Tu Ye transmigrated into the body of a young emperor, he just wanted to live life as a spoiled king and let his kingdom die out so he could go back home. But all the "tyrannical" things he did ended up helping somehow. Step by step, the originally doomed Kingdom of Gan is on the way to becoming the most powerful empire in the world…! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: Super Son-in-Law in Another World
works.synopsis: Qin Shi, an ordinary undergraduate, accidentally goes through the time-space journey and becomes the leader of an evil sect. But this sect is so unreliable that the fund is raised by the leader through marital fraud. Qin Shi wants to resign as this position. This story is about a leader who sticks to core socialist values. (Source: wecomics)

works.title: Yue Lao Bu Zhun Wo Lianai
works.synopsis: Instead of pulling the red strings of fate between the humans, the god of marriage descended to earth to stop someone from dating. The protagonist's marriage is the key for the world's end. This is a comedic romantic cohabitation story between a workaholic god of marriage and a hot-tempered teacher.

works.title: Ruwei
works.synopsis: While getting a nighttime snack, the illustrator Xin Xin runs into Yin Yin, a rich girl drunk and wasted on the street. Xin Xin takes her home, cleans her up, and even makes her a bowl of hot-and-sour noodle soup when she wakes up hungry... After some back-and-forth, Xin Xin ends up letting the "homeless" Yin Yin stay, as she needs a new roommate anyway. Bit by bit, the beautiful and outgoing Yin Yin chips away the icy facade of the serious and independent Xin Xin... (Source: Bilibili, translated)

works.title: My Covenant with the Monster Lord
works.synopsis: Loyal king of demons said, "Now that you've found me, you need to be responsible for me." Lost memories and destined reunion. Yu Yin reincarnated twice and returned to the world he was originally from, but he got "scammed" by some unknown demon king the moment he's back. Moreover, he got bitten by him and formed an agreement! While Yu Yin was in astonishment, the demon king considered everything just normal. "I surely need to be responsible for you, given the relationship between us." (Source: MangaToon)

works.title: Beast of Blue Obsidian
works.synopsis: In the year 3574 of the Lista calendar, the world started moving toward destruction. In this already decaying world, 500 years later, the black-robed-elf Ariman Campbell takes over an Orc-female beast, Eve, by accident. Their meeting set the wheel of fate in motion, which could lead to a major storm... (Source: INKR)

works.title: The Brilliant Miss Olive
works.synopsis: Olive Fu was not going to have it! Instead of being forced to marry an old man, she takes a leap to determine her own fate. Enthusiastic and strong-willed, she's embarked on a quest to build her jewelry business. But out in the real world, things get messy fast when she bumps into and then hires a handsome stranger (with his own secrets!) to be her assistant. Will she be able to break free from her old life at the risk of becoming entangled in something new? (Source: Tapas)

works.title: Xiao Yang Xiangdao Cong Bu Zuoyou Weinan
works.ar: 小羊向导从不左右为难
works.synopsis: The twin brothers love me too much. What should I do? D-class guide Qiao Yang, because of a drunken accident, discovered that he could use the two A-class sentinels, his childhood friends Zheng Jia and Zheng Yan, to enhance his own class. In order to retain this rare S-class status, he chose to conceal his exploitation of them. However, during the repeated interaction with the two, he gradually becomes aware of their feelings towards him… (Source: Bilibili, translated) Note: Originally serialized under the title “Kao Fa Xiaowo Bianshen Dingji Xiangdao (靠发小我变身顶级向导)”.

works.title: The Advanced Soul
works.synopsis: Jiang Chengfeng is a confident and arrogant teenager who has atheist views ever since he was a child. Due to an accident in the past, he has the power to defeat evil spirits turning him into an exorcist. Jiang Chengfeng uses his power to defeat every demon and spirit in order to challenge the Lord. (Source: INKR)

works.title: Machspeed Starscars
works.synopsis: Darkness’ devouring energy and mysterious space energy. The two different types of energy appeared in one person. A glance that can kill? That is the power of space. Men will be raped by beautiful women? That is the fate of the protagonist? In a world with Special powers, Vampires, Witches and Demons, where the forces of Darkness and Light collides. His women will be his guiding lights and change his fate!

works.title: Vampire Sphere
works.synopsis: The unforeseen destiny of cloned triplets. Zhaoyan, Xiyan, and Yuejian’s lives take an unexpected turn after they are injected with a serum that controls demon bloodlines. And in this world of vampires and hunters, they must overcome every obstacle that comes their way. How will the serum change their fates? Can they rise up to the challenge? (Source: Manta)

works.title: Love After the Break
works.synopsis: Landon forced Zayden to go from Alpha to Omega. Zayden endured the pain, the rejection, and finally walked away after the divorce. Only when he was gone did Landon realize... he’d made the biggest mistake of his life. (Source: WebComics)

works.title: BLISS: Ends of Gods
works.synopsis: In a barren, post-apocalyptic wasteland, a silver-haired, one-armed survivor journeys alone, fueled by an unrelenting spark of hope. Her path leads to a gleaming city that stands as a beacon of prosperity—yet beneath its shimmering façade lies a sinister secret that could shatter everything she believes in. (Source: Bilibili Comics)

works.title: Master's Flirting With Me Again!
works.synopsis: Ten years ago, he lost his parents to demons. In order to get revenge, he’ll need to… listen to his master?! The master combs his hair, tells him what to wear, and in return, requires him to be obedient as his living weapon and more.

works.title: A Legend of the Wind
works.synopsis: An ordinary young man's bloody journey of ascension from ordinary to extraordinary, and from the trough to the peak. In the 16th generation of the Shangguan family of Shangguan Xu, he is ever-changing and looks like a ghost. He comes and goes without a trace. He discovered the correct method of practicing the family martial arts, and changed his life.

works.title: Yi Xing Yu Ni
works.synopsis: A high school girl who moonlights as a mangaka has a chance encounter with the girl she based her main character of off.

works.title: Shuang Jian Tou
works.synopsis: What disease does this patient have, that she still isn't cured after so many visits to the hospital… The answer will shock you! (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

works.title: Zai Chongman Guaitan De Shijie Li Chengwei Monü
works.ar: 在充满怪谈的世界里成为魔女
works.synopsis: Day 1: I must be seeing things. Wait, did that cabinet just move? Better check. Day 3: I see them now! Damn it! Why is this world so full of supernatural beings!? Day 101: Well, there's nothing to be afraid of! Time to put on my witchy dress and join them! (Source: Tencent, translated)

works.title: A Dragon in the Abyss
works.synopsis: A born failure is posessed by a dragon. He's bestowed with the will and power of this magical creature. With scales and claws, he can travel on water and breath fire. He summons rains and wins every battle. This is the time when everyone wants to slay the dragon and Li Muyang has always been feeling a lot of pressure. The reason is, he is the last dragon on this continent. (Source: Wecomics) Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.

works.title: Mowang Daren Zong Liao Wo
works.synopsis: He Mian, a college student who has social anxiety, clears his favorite game for the 100th time. Gareth, the devil of the game, accidentally transmigrates into the modern world where He Mian is. He Mian is determined to return the devil back to the game as soon as possible. In order to get rid of Gareth's pranks and entanglements, the two must collect magical artifacts from the game which have been scattered across the world. (Source: Kuaikan, translated) Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.
